## MCP Index Page Investigation Report

### 1. LOCATION OF MCP INDEX PAGE

**There is no dedicated MCP index page.** Instead, MCPs are browsed via **category filtering on a unified extensions listing page**:
- **File**: `/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/app/pages/extensions/index.vue`
- **Access**: `/extensions?category=mcp` (or the locale-prefixed equivalent via i18n strategy)
- The "MCP Servers" nav link in TopBar routes to this same page with `query: { category: 'mcp' }`

This is architecturally correct — the codebase treats extensions as a single taxonomy with four categories (`skills`, `mcp`, `slash`, `plugins`), not as separate listing pages.

### 2. FULL SOURCE: EXTENSIONS INDEX PAGE

**File**: `app/pages/extensions/index.vue`

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ArrowUpRight, Search } from "lucide-vue-next"

definePageMeta({ layout: "browse" })

const { t } = useI18n()
const route = useRoute()
const { filters, update } = useFilters()
const localePath = useLocalePath()

const { data, pending, refresh } = await useFetch("/api/internal/extensions", {
  query: computed(() => route.query),
  default: () => ({ items: [], total: 0, filters: {} }),
})

// Facets don't depend on filters — fetch once and reuse across navigations.
const { data: facets } = await useFetch("/api/internal/facets", {
  default: () => ({ creators: [], publishers: [], tags: [] }),
})

watch(() => route.fullPath, () => refresh())

const items = computed(() => data.value?.items ?? [])
const total = computed(() => data.value?.total ?? 0)
const query = computed(() => filters.value.q)
const filtersActive = computed(() => {
  const f = filters.value
  return Object.keys(f).some((k) => k !== "page" && f[k as keyof typeof f] !== undefined)
})
const isMcpCategory = computed(() => route.query.category === "mcp")

const q = ref<string>(typeof route.query.q === "string" ? route.query.q : "")
let pushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null

function pushQuery() {
  if (pushTimer) {
    clearTimeout(pushTimer)
    pushTimer = null
  }
  const trimmed = q.value.trim()
  update({ q: trimmed || undefined })
}

function flushSearch() {
  pushQuery()
}

watch(q, () => {
  if (pushTimer) clearTimeout(pushTimer)
  pushTimer = setTimeout(pushQuery, 250)
})

// Keep the local input in sync when the URL changes from outside the input
// (back button, chip dismissal, "Clear all").
watch(
  () => route.query.q,
  (next) => {
    const incoming = typeof next === "string" ? next : ""
    if (incoming !== q.value) q.value = incoming
  },
)

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (pushTimer) clearTimeout(pushTimer)
})
</script>

<template>
  <div class="px-6 py-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
    <div class="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      <form
        role="search"
        class="relative flex-1 min-w-[240px]"
        @submit.prevent="flushSearch"
      >
        <label class="sr-only" for="extensions-search">{{ t("nav.searchLabel") }}</label>
        <Search
          :size="16"
          class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-(--color-ink-muted) pointer-events-none"
          aria-hidden="true"

      <NuxtLink

        :to="localePath('/mcp-panorama')"

      >
        {{ t("extensions.mcpPanoramaLink") }}
        <ArrowUpRight :size="14" aria-hidden="true" />
      </NuxtLink>
      <SortSelect />
    </div>

    <FilterBar
      :creators="facets.creators"
      :publishers="facets.publishers"
      :tags="facets.tags"
    />

    <ResultsSummary
      :count="total"
      :creators="facets.creators"
      :publishers="facets.publishers"
      :tags="facets.tags"
    />

    <ExtGridSkeleton v-if="pending && items.length === 0" />
    <ExtGrid
      v-else
      :items="items"
      :query="query"
      :clear-filters-href="filtersActive ? localePath('/extensions') : undefined"
    />

</template>

### 3. PARALLEL PAGES & STRUCTURE COMPARISON

All extension categories use the **same page template** (`/extensions`) with **identical visual hierarchy**:

| Aspect | Skills | MCP | Slash Commands | Plugins |
|--------|--------|-----|-----------------|---------|
| **Route** | `/extensions?category=skills` | `/extensions?category=mcp` | `/extensions?category=slash` | `/extensions?category=plugins` |
| **Nav Link** | TopBar PRIMARY | TopBar PRIMARY | TopBar → "More" menu | TopBar → "More" menu |
| **Search** | Yes, same search input | Yes, same search input | Yes, same search input | Yes, same search input |
| **Filter Rail** | ScopePills, Dept, Creator, Publisher, Tag Drawer | Same | Same | Same |
| **Card Grid** | ExtGrid + ExtCard | Same | Same | Same |
| **Empty State** | ExtGrid (SearchX icon, friendly msg) | Same | Same | Same |
| **Special CTA** | None | "View the MCP Panorama" link (accent blue, top-right) | None | None |
| **Results Summary** | ResultsSummary chip rail below filter bar | Same | Same | Same |

**Key Difference**: The MCP category alone gets a **conditional accent-colored CTA** (line 87–92) that links to `/mcp-panorama` when `isMcpCategory` is true. No other category has this.

**Collections page** (`/collections/index.vue`) is entirely separate with its own layout, grid, and pagination — not a category within extensions.

### 5. DATA FLOW: HOW MCP PAGE GETS DATA

**Server Route**: `server/api/internal/extensions.get.ts`

```typescript
export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {
  const url = getRequestURL(event)
  const filters = parseFilters(searchParamsToInput(url.searchParams))

  try {
    const db = useDb()
    const [items, total] = await Promise.all([
      extensionsRepo.findManyForList(db, filters),
      extensionsRepo.countFiltered(db, filters),
    ])
    return { items, total, filters }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[api/internal/extensions] db error:", err)
    throw createError({
      statusCode: 500,
      statusMessage: "Failed to load extensions",
    })
  }
})
```

**Client Call** (extensions/index.vue, lines 11–14):
```typescript
const { data, pending, refresh } = await useFetch("/api/internal/extensions", {
  query: computed(() => route.query),
  default: () => ({ items: [], total: 0, filters: {} }),
})
```

**Query Parameters Passed Through**:
- `category: "mcp"` (from `route.query.category`)
- `q?: string` (search term)
- `scope?: "personal" | "org" | "enterprise"`
- `dept?: string` (department ID)
- `creator?: string` (user ID of publisher)
- `publisher?: string` (org ID owner)
- `tags?: string[]` (comma-joined)
- `filter?: "official" | "popular" | "new" | "trending" | "free"`
- `sort?: "downloads" | "stars" | "recent"`
- `page?: number`

**Repository Layer** (`server/repositories/extensions.ts`, lines 165–177):
```typescript
export async function findManyForList(
  tx: Transactable,
  filters: Filters,
): Promise<ExtensionListItem[]> {
  const where = buildExtensionWhere(filters)
  const order = buildExtensionOrder(filters)
  const sql = tx
    .select(listSelect)
    .from(extensions)
    .leftJoin(extensionTags, eq(extensions.id, extensionTags.extensionId))
    .where(and(where, filters.category && eq(extensions.category, filters.category)))
    .groupBy(extensions.id)
    .orderBy(...order)
    .limit(PAGE_SIZE + 1)
    .offset(pageOffset(filters.page))
  return sql
}
```

**Scope**: `WHERE extensions.category = 'mcp'` is applied via Drizzle `eq(extensions.category, filters.category)` when the query param is present. No implicit default — if `category` is omitted, all categories are returned.

**Facets** (line 17–19): fetched once independently:
```typescript
const { data: facets } = await useFetch("/api/internal/facets", {
  default: () => ({ creators: [], publishers: [], tags: [] }),
})
```

Populated by `server/api/internal/facets.get.ts` (independently of active filters) so picker options remain stable across filter changes.

### 6. STYLING BASELINE

#### Typography
- **Page title/headings**: None currently (extensions/index.vue is filterless). Home has `text-3xl sm:text-4xl` serif.
- **Search input**: `text-sm` (13px), `h-9`, placeholder uses `--color-ink-muted`
- **Filter pills**: `text-[12px] font-semibold`, `px-2.5 py-0.5`, `rounded-full`
- **Card title**: `text-[15px] font-semibold`, `tracking-tight`
- **Card description**: `text-[13px]` on 1.55 line-height, 3-line clamp
- **Card metadata**: `font-mono text-[12px]`, `--color-ink-muted` color
- **Results summary**: `font-mono text-[12px]`
- **MCP Panorama CTA**: `text-[13px] font-medium`, `text-(--color-accent)`, arrow grows on hover

#### Fonts (per CLAUDE.md)
- **Display/headings**: Fraunces (serif, italic in headers)
- **UI**: Inter
- **Tags/counts/metadata**: JetBrains Mono

#### Grid & Spacing
- **Page padding**: `px-6 py-8` (24px sides, 32px top/bottom)
- **Page max-width**: `max-w-7xl` (80rem = 1280px)
- **Card grid**: `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr))] gap-4`
  - Mobile: 1 column
  - Tablet+: auto-fill with 320px minimum, 16px gap
  - Typical result: 3–4 cards per row on 1280px viewport
- **Card spacing**: `p-5` internal padding, `rounded-(--radius-card)` (10px), `border border-(--color-border)`
- **Filter rail**: `mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2`
- **Search + sort row**: `mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3`

#### Colors (themes)
- **Light (Editorial Ivory, default)**:
  - `--color-bg`: oklch(98.5% 0.008 80) — near-white
  - `--color-card`: #ffffff
  - `--color-border`: oklch(92% 0.012 70) — subtle grey
  - `--color-ink`: oklch(22% 0.02 60) — charcoal
  - `--color-ink-muted`: oklch(48% 0.015 60) — mid-grey
  - `--color-accent`: oklch(40% 0.09 35) — saturated orange-yellow
- **Dark**:
  - `--color-bg`: oklch(14% 0.006 240) — very dark blue
  - `--color-card`: oklch(19% 0.008 240)
  - `--color-accent`: oklch(72% 0.18 200) — bright cyan
- **Mono**:
  - All chroma removed (pure grayscale)
  - `--color-accent`: oklch(22% 0 0) — black

#### Accent Restraint (Decision #11)
- **Currently used on extensions page**:
  - MCP Panorama link: `text-(--color-accent)` only (blue text, no fill)
  - Search input focus ring: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-(--color-accent)`
  - Filter chips on hover: neutral border/text, no accent
  - Card hover: `hover:border-(--color-accent)/30` (tinted border, not fill)
  
- **Not used** (per spec):
  - Filter pill active states: `bg-(--color-ink)/8` (neutral, not accent)
  - Sort dropdown: neutral
  - Empty state: neutral
  
**Result**: The page is visually quiet; accent is sparse and intentional.

#### Borders & Separators
- Cards: `border border-(--color-border)` only, no bottom divider
- Filter bar: no `border-b` below (sitting directly above results summary)
- Search input: subtle `border-(--color-border)` + focus ring

#### Implication for MCP:
The home is now **aggressively curated and singular** (skills only, install-focused). MCP is intentionally pushed to:
1. TopBar nav (equal to Skills, visible on md+)
2. Dedicated `/mcp-panorama` (visualization tool)

There's **no MCP equivalent of HomeDiscovery**. The home does not surface MCPs.

### 8. WHAT FEELS ROUGH OR INCONSISTENT IN MCP LISTING

Examining the current `/extensions?category=mcp` page against the home's new baseline:

1. **No Page Header**
   - Home has hero + discovery title with subtitle. Extensions listing has neither.
   - Search and filters drop immediately into the grid.
   - **Opportunity**: Add a page header (h1, subtitle, MCP-specific intro) that sets context and guides first-time users.

2. **Conditional CTA Feels Tacked On**
   - The "View the MCP Panorama" link (accent-blue, top-right) only appears when `isMcpCategory === true`.
   - It's a one-off; skills don't get an equivalent "View Skills Map" link.
   - Position: wedged between search and sort, feels reactive rather than intentional.
   - **Opportunity**: Elevate this to a proper page-level section (hero or promo band) that explains what MCPs are and why the panorama matters.

3. **No Category Scoping Signal**
   - The page doesn't declare "You're browsing MCP Servers" anywhere.
   - A user arriving via `/extensions` (no category param) sees all categories mixed.
   - **Opportunity**: Add a page title or filter rail badge that makes the current category visible.

4. **Search Input Re-use**
   - The search input logic (debounced `q` watcher, route sync) is solid, but there's no MCP-specific search copy or UX refinement.
   - **Opportunity**: Could offer MCP-specific search tips or contextual placeholder if category-aware.

5. **Filter Rail Feels Generic**
   - All four categories use identical filters (Scope, Dept, Creator, Publisher, Tags).
   - MCPs might benefit from MCP-specific filters (e.g., "Tier" from the MCP spec, "Protocol version", "Stateless/Stateful").
   - Current UI doesn't differentiate.
   - **Opportunity**: If MCP-specific filters exist in the data model, expose them; otherwise, consider a future refinement.

6. **Disconnect from Panorama**
   - The panorama is a rich, specialized visualization; the listing is a flat grid.
   - Users don't know which view to use when.
   - **Opportunity**: Add explanatory copy or a comparison band on the page explaining: "Panorama = explore by ecosystem; List = search & filter by metadata."

7. **Empty State Genericity**
   - ExtGrid shows a generic "No extensions match these filters" message.
   - For MCP, could say "No MCP servers found" or offer MCP-specific guidance.
   - **Opportunity**: Make empty states category-aware.

8. **No Hero or Visual Anchor**
   - Home now has a careful radial-gradient hero with typography hierarchy. Extensions listing is flat.
   - Creates a cohesion gap between home → clicking "MCP Servers" → landing on a featureless filter-and-grid page.
   - **Opportunity**: Add a subtle hero band (not as heavy as home, but more than nothing) to set the page's tone and scope.

## SUMMARY

**The MCP index page is currently `/extensions?category=mcp`** — a unified listing powered by the `extensions/index.vue` page with category-aware filtering. It shares all components (FilterBar, ExtGrid, ExtCard, ResultsSummary) with Skills, Slash Commands, and Plugins.

**Key assets**:
- Solid data flow via `/api/internal/extensions` with Drizzle filtering by `category`
- Responsive grid (`320px` min, `gap-4`)
- Quiet, neutral styling that respects decision #11 (accent restraint)
- One MCP-specific CTA: "View the MCP Panorama" link (accent color, top-right)

**Cohesion gaps** (vs. home's new refinement):
1. No page header or context-setting intro
2. MCP-specific CTA feels orphaned, not structural
3. No visual signal of current category scope
4. Filter rail is identical to other categories (no MCP-specific metadata)
5. Disconnect between list view and panorama view (no guidance on when to use which)
6. Empty state doesn't acknowledge it's an MCP-specific view
7. No hero or visual anchor (home now has radial-gradient hero; listing is flat)
8. Missing MCP-specific search copy or UX nudges

**Elegance opportunities** (not fixes, just observations for planning):
- Add a page header (h1, subtitle, intro copy) that contextualizes MCP servers and guides users toward the panorama when appropriate
- Restructure the MCP Panorama CTA into a proper promo band or hero section instead of a top-right link
- Expose category in the filter rail or page title (e.g., active pill or breadcrumb)
- Investigate MCP-specific filters (tier, protocol version, status) and expose if data supports
- Add explanatory copy (band or help text) distinguishing list view (search/filter) from panorama view (ecosystem exploration)
- Make empty states and search placeholders category-aware
- Consider a subtle hero band to harmonize with home's new visual language (radial gradient, centered type, clear hierarchy)

31	
32	const q = ref<string>(typeof route.query.q === "string" ? route.query.q : "")
33	let pushTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
34	
35	function pushQuery() {
36	  if (pushTimer) {
37	    clearTimeout(pushTimer)
38	    pushTimer = null
39	  }
40	  const trimmed = q.value.trim()
41	  update({ q: trimmed || undefined })
42	}
43	
44	function flushSearch() {
45	  pushQuery()
46	}
47	
48	watch(q, () => {
49	  if (pushTimer) clearTimeout(pushTimer)
50	  pushTimer = setTimeout(pushQuery, 250)
51	})
52	
53	// Keep the local input in sync when the URL changes from outside the input
54	// (back button, chip dismissal, "Clear all").
55	watch(
56	  () => route.query.q,
57	  (next) => {
58	    const incoming = typeof next === "string" ? next : ""
59	    if (incoming !== q.value) q.value = incoming
60	  },
61	)
62	
63	onBeforeUnmount(() => {
64	  if (pushTimer) clearTimeout(pushTimer)
65	})
66	</script>

  "content": "# MCP Index Page — Elegance Pass\n\n## Context\n\nThe \"MCP index\" today is the unified browse page at `app/pages/extensions/index.vue`, accessed via `/extensions?category=mcp`. Theme cycle in TopBar — Editorial Ivory, Dark, Mono Clean — header reads cleanly in each, no border-b artifact, accent restraint preserved (only the Panorama link picks up theme accent).\n9. Responsive — at <640px the header and the Panorama link stack via `flex-wrap`; the title + intro sit above the search; at `sm+` the row is balanced.\n10. Run `bun run typecheck` (and `bun run lint` if available); zero new diagnostics. No new component imports needed in `extensions/index.vue` — `ArrowUpRight` and `Search` already imported.\n\n## Out of scope (call out, don't do)\n\n- MCP-specific filters (tier, protocol version) — would require schema changes; not in this pass.\n- A promo band explaining list-vs-panorama — user picked the quieter header-pair option.\n- Splitting the unified page into per-category routes — user picked the category-aware unified page.\n- Touching the home, `mcp-panorama.vue`, FilterBar, or ExtCard.\n"

## Approved Plan:
# MCP Index Page — Elegance Pass

## Context

The "MCP index" today is the unified browse page at `app/pages/extensions/index.vue`, accessed via `/extensions?category=mcp`. There is no dedicated `/mcp` route — every category (skills, MCP, slash, plugins) shares the same page.

The page currently has no header, no scope signal, and no intro. It drops the visitor straight into a search input, with an awkwardly-placed "View the MCP Panorama" link wedged between the search and the sort dropdown when (and only when) `category=mcp`. The link is the only thing telling a user they're in the MCP context.

Meanwhile the home (this branch, `refactor/home-cohesion-pass`) has been refined toward visual restraint: serif heading, no hard dividers, accent used sparingly, "let differentials carry." Landing on the MCP listing from there feels like a cohesion drop — featureless, generic, and the panorama link reads as an afterthought.

User picked: keep the unified page, add a **quiet header pair** (title + intro left, panorama link right for MCP), make copy **category-aware** for title, intro, search placeholder, and empty states.

## Approach

Add a single category-aware header section to `extensions/index.vue` above the existing search/sort row. The header sets context (which category am I browsing) and elevates the MCP Panorama link from a top-right wedge to a structural secondary action paired with the title.

Derive title, intro, search placeholder, and an empty-state label from a single `categoryKey` computed off `route.query.category`. Pass the label down to `ExtGrid` so its empty states read "No MCP servers match these filters" instead of "No extensions match these filters."

No new components. No hero gradient (the home owns that visual weight; the listing should stay workmanlike). No border below the header — per recent home commits, trust spacing to carry the transition.

## Files to modify

1. **`app/pages/extensions/index.vue`** (`extensions/index.vue:68-122`)
   - Add a header block above the existing search row (`:70`).
   - Add `categoryKey`, `title`, `intro`, `searchPlaceholder`, `categoryLabel` computeds derived from `route.query.category`.
   - Replace the placeholder on the search `<input>` (`:86`) with the category-aware one.
   - Move the existing `<NuxtLink>` to `/mcp-panorama` (currently at `:90-97`) out of the search row and into the right side of the new header.
   - Pass `:category-label="categoryLabel"` into `<ExtGrid>` (`:115`).

2. **`app/components/extension/ExtGrid.vue`** (`ExtGrid.vue:5-9`)
   - Add an optional `categoryLabel?: string` prop.
   - Pass `{ label: props.categoryLabel ?? t("extensions.empty.defaultLabel") }` into the existing `t()` calls for `noResultsFiltered` (`:24`) and `noExtensionsYet` (`:25`). `noResultsFor` already has `{query}` and stays as-is.

3. **`i18n/locales/en.json`** (extends the existing `extensions` block at `en.json:62`)
   - Add an `extensions.category` block with five entries (`all`, `skills`, `mcp`, `slash`, `plugins`), each containing `title`, `intro`, `searchPlaceholder`, `label`.
   - Add `extensions.empty.defaultLabel: "extensions"`.
   - Update `extensions.empty.noResultsFiltered` and `noExtensionsYet` strings to interpolate `{label}`.

4. **`i18n/locales/zh.json`** — mirror the EN additions in Chinese (paths line up at `zh.json:62` / `:90`).

## Header design

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  MCP Servers                              View the MCP Panorama  ↗  │
│  Tool servers built on the Model Context                            │
│  Protocol. Browse by name, or jump to the                           │
│  Panorama for a map of the ecosystem.                               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  [ 🔍 Search MCP servers… ]                            [Sort: ⌄]
  [scope] [dept] [creator] [publisher] [+ tags]
  …grid…
```

Container: `mb-6 sm:mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4` — no `border-b`.

- **h1**: `font-serif text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight text-(--color-ink)` — deliberately smaller than the home hero (`text-3xl ... sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl`) so the listing reads as secondary.
- **Intro `<p>`**: `mt-2 max-w-xl text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-(--color-ink-muted)`.
- **Right slot** (Panorama link, MCP only): keep the existing classes — `inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-(--color-accent) hover:gap-2 transition-[gap]` with `ArrowUpRight` size 14. This stays the page's one intentional accent moment per decision #11.

For categories other than MCP, the right slot is empty; the title block sits alone on the left of an unbalanced row, which is fine — flex-wrap handles the layout naturally.

## Wiring (in `extensions/index.vue`)

```ts
type CategoryKey = "all" | "skills" | "mcp" | "slash" | "plugins"

const categoryKey = computed<CategoryKey>(() => {
  const c = route.query.category
  return c === "skills" || c === "mcp" || c === "slash" || c === "plugins" ? c : "all"
})
const title = computed(() => t(`extensions.category.${categoryKey.value}.title`))
const intro = computed(() => t(`extensions.category.${categoryKey.value}.intro`))
const searchPlaceholder = computed(() => t(`extensions.category.${categoryKey.value}.searchPlaceholder`))
const categoryLabel = computed(() => t(`extensions.category.${categoryKey.value}.label`))
```

`isMcpCategory` (already at `:30`) is preserved and reused to gate the right-side Panorama link.

## What stays unchanged

- Data flow — `useFetch("/api/internal/extensions", { query: route.query })` and `/api/internal/facets` (`:11-19`).
- `FilterBar`, `ResultsSummary`, `ExtGridSkeleton`, `ExtCard`, `SortSelect` — no signature changes.
- Decision #3 — single-row quiet pill rail FilterBar is untouched; the new header sits **above** the search row, not inside the filter rail.
- Decision #11 — accent restraint preserved; only the Panorama link uses accent, only on `category=mcp`. The header title and intro are neutral ink, no tinted fills.
- Page padding (`px-6 py-8`), max-width (`max-w-7xl`), layout (`browse`).
- Search input behavior — debounce, route sync, `onBeforeUnmount` cleanup (`:32-65`) all stay.
- `mcpPanoramaLink` i18n key — already exists in both locales (`en.json:104`, `zh.json:104`), reused verbatim.

## Verification

Run `bun run dev` and walk through each scenario in a browser:

2. `/en/extensions?category=mcp` — header reads "MCP Servers" with the MCP intro; Panorama link visible at top-right; placeholder reads "Search MCP servers…".
3. `/en/extensions?category=skills` — header reads "Skills"; no Panorama link; skills placeholder.
4. `/en/extensions?category=slash` and `?category=plugins` — equivalent treatment for those categories.
5. `/en/extensions?category=mcp&q=zzzzzzzz` — empty state shows `No results for "zzzzzzzz"` (unchanged path).
6. `/en/extensions?category=mcp&tags=__no_match__` — empty state shows "No MCP servers match these filters" (the new category-aware label).
7. `/zh/extensions?category=mcp` — Chinese title, intro, placeholder, and empty state all render.
8. Theme cycle in TopBar — Editorial Ivory, Dark, Mono Clean — header reads cleanly in each, no border-b artifact, accent restraint preserved (only the Panorama link picks up theme accent).
9. Responsive — at <640px the header and the Panorama link stack via `flex-wrap`; the title + intro sit above the search; at `sm+` the row is balanced.
10. Run `bun run typecheck` (and `bun run lint` if available); zero new diagnostics. No new component imports needed in `extensions/index.vue` — `ArrowUpRight` and `Search` already imported.

## Out of scope (call out, don't do)

- MCP-specific filters (tier, protocol version) — would require schema changes; not in this pass.

- Touching the home, `mcp-panorama.vue`, FilterBar, or ExtCard.

Done. Here's what changed for the MCP listing's elegance pass:

**Files modified**
- `app/pages/extensions/index.vue` — added a quiet category-aware header (Fraunces serif h1 + muted intro), moved the "View the MCP Panorama" link out of the search row into the header's right side (still MCP-only), and wired up category-aware search placeholder + empty-state label.
- `app/components/extension/ExtGrid.vue` — accepts a new `categoryLabel` prop; empty-state copy now interpolates "No MCP servers match these filters" instead of the generic "extensions" wording.
- `i18n/locales/en.json` and `zh.json` — added `extensions.category.{all,skills,mcp,slash,plugins}.{title,intro,searchPlaceholder,label}`; updated `extensions.empty.noResultsFiltered` and `noExtensionsYet` to interpolate `{label}` (with a `defaultLabel` fallback so existing call sites keep working).

**Verified end-to-end** by booting `bun run dev` and curling four routes:
- `/en/extensions?category=mcp` → header "MCP Servers" + MCP intro + "Search MCP servers…" + Panorama link present.
- `/en/extensions?category=skills` → "Skills" header + skills intro + skills placeholder + **no** Panorama link.
- `/en/extensions` → "Browse the registry" with the all-categories intro, no Panorama link.
- `/zh/extensions?category=mcp` → Chinese title, intro, placeholder, Panorama link all rendering.

**Also clean**: `bun run lint` (no output), `bun run typecheck` (no `error TS`), `bun run test` (244 passed). No border below the header — spacing carries the transition, in line with the home cohesion direction.

Per the Vercel session reminder: the Vercel CLI is at 53.4.0 — recommend `npm i -g vercel@latest` when you have a moment, but I didn't act on that since it wasn't part of the task.

Now I have all the information I need. Let me compile a comprehensive report:

---

## Fitness Check

### (1) Move Panorama Link into Browse Layout Sidebar + Framing as Dual View Mode

**Assessment: Moderate friction, not blocking but requires coordination.**

The codebase separates concerns cleanly between the `browse` layout (used by `/extensions`, which houses the `Sidebar` component) and the dedicated `mcp-panorama` layout (which owns its own `LayerSidebar`). The current `Sidebar` is deeply focused on taxonomy navigation (`FUNC_TAXONOMY` tree), not category-aware chrome. Integrating the Panorama link would require either:

1. Passing `isMcpCategory` context through a new prop to `Sidebar`, then rendering a conditional "View options" section, OR
2. Lifting the link higher into `browse.vue` and inserting it into the sidebar's header/footer slot (requires adding a slot to `Sidebar`).

The framing "View: List | Panorama" (both filtering the same MCP data) is **semantically accurate** — the panorama page, despite having its own layout and data shape (Groups → Domains/Sectors → Tools → MCPs), calls the same `/api/internal/mcp-landscape` endpoint and supports the same filtering (status, layer). However, the data transformation is significant: the list view on panorama renders `GroupedListView`, which recomposes the hierarchy differently than `ExtGrid`. The landing is clean enough, but avoid overselling them as "same content, different view" — they're more like "complementary views of the same dataset."

**Minor blockers:** You'd want a small nav control (radio/toggle) in the sidebar that clearly owns both view modes. The current styling assumptions (`font-mono text-[12px]`, minimal padding) may need adjustment to feel balanced in sidebar real estate.

---

### (2) Move Sort Control onto ResultsSummary Row

**Assessment: Surgical fit; few dependencies; recommend.**

The `ResultsSummary` component already owns the "Showing X" count row. Adding the `SortSelect` dropdown here aligns with information architecture: counts and ordering are the two metadata levers on the result set. The component has room — currently it's a flex row with `gap-x-3 gap-y-2` (line 138) wrapping the count text and filter chips. The sort control is visually compatible: `SortSelect` renders at `text-[12px]` in a compact label/select pair (no icons, no padding bloat beyond `px-2 py-1`).

No reuse friction: `ResultsSummary` is only called once (in `extensions/index.vue` line 119–124). The `SortSelect` is only used in that same file (line 110). Moving it is a clean refactor.

**Visual density is OK**: The row already wraps on mobile (`flex-wrap items-center`), so adding the sort dropdown won't break. However, you'll want to confirm spacing on narrow viewports — the sort control may wrap to a second line if filter chips are present, which is acceptable but worth eye-balling.

---

## Per-Section Findings

### 1. Browse Layout Sidebar — `/app/layouts/browse.vue`

**Full file:** 35 lines. The layout is a minimal shell:
- Header (TopBar) — sticky at `top-0`, height 16
- Aside (sidebar) — sticky at `top-16` (below header), hidden on `md:` breakpoint, `w-[240px]`, height `[calc(100vh-4rem)]`, **overflow-hidden** (so scrollable content inside)
- Main slot — flex-1, `min-w-0`, takes remaining width

The sidebar is **not category-aware** — it simply renders the `<Sidebar />` component. No props, no context passed. No conditional rendering.

**Key structure (lines 22–28):**
```vue
<aside
  class="hidden md:flex sticky top-16 self-start h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] w-[240px] overflow-hidden flex-col"
  role="navigation"
  :aria-label="t('sidebar.categories')"
>
  <Sidebar />
</aside>
```

---

### 2. Sidebar Component — `/app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue`

**Full file:** 95 lines. This is a static taxonomy navigator, **not category-aware**.

**Structure:**
- H2 title: "Categories" (line 32)
- Flex col of links, each built with `buildHref()` that mutates `funcCat`, `subCat`, `l2` query params while preserving others (`category`, `q`, etc.)
- Three-level collapsible taxonomy: `FUNC_TAXONOMY` array → `.l1` → `.l2`
- All links preserve the URL except the three taxonomy params; logic is in `buildHref()` (lines 13–25)

**No props.** The component accesses `route.query` directly and builds hrefs conditionally. To add MCP panorama link, you'd either:
- Add a slot (`#sidebar-footer`, `#sidebar-header`), or
- Pass `isMcpCategory: boolean` as a prop and render a conditional block inside Sidebar

**Visual weight:** The sidebar is `overflow-y-auto` with `[scrollbar-width:none]` (hidden scrollbar). Content is `px-5 py-3`, links have `text-[13.5px]–[15px]` and `py-1.5–1.5`. A "View options" section would fit naturally at the top or bottom; **recommend placing it above the h2** (line 32) or as a separator `<hr>` + toggle control.

---

### 3. ResultsSummary Component — `/app/components/extension/ResultsSummary.vue`

**Full file:** 165 lines. This component is the "Showing X" + filter chips + "Clear all" row.

**Current layout (lines 137–165):**
```vue
<div class="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
  <p class="text-(--color-ink-muted) font-mono text-[12px]">
    {{ count > 0 ? t("extensions.summary.showing", { count }) : ... }}
  </p>

  <div v-if="hasChips" class="flex flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
    <!-- Filter chips with X buttons -->
  </div>
</div>
```

- **Spacing:** `gap-x-3 gap-y-2` with `flex-wrap` — well-behaved on mobile
- **Density:** The "Showing X" count is `font-mono text-[12px]`, very compact
- **Reuse:** Used only in `extensions/index.vue` (line 119–124). No other callers.
- **Props:** Takes `count`, `creators[]`, `publishers[]`, `tags[]` (facets for label lookup in chips)

**Room for sort?** Yes. The sort dropdown (`text-[12px]` select in a label) would sit naturally after the count or before the chips. No prop additions needed; `SortSelect` is already wired to `useFilters()`, same composable.

---

### 4. SortSelect Component — `/app/components/filters/SortSelect.vue`

**Full file:** 35 lines. A label wrapping a native select dropdown.

**Current structure (lines 19–34):**
```vue
<label
  :aria-label="t('filters.sortLabel')"
  class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-card) px-2 py-1 text-(--color-ink-muted) transition-colors focus-within:border-(--color-ink)/40 hover:text-(--color-ink)"
>
  <ArrowDownUp :size="12" aria-hidden="true" />
  <select
    :value="active"
    class="cursor-pointer bg-transparent text-(--color-ink) text-[12px] outline-none"
    @change="onChange"
  >
    <option v-for="key in SORT_KEYS" :key="key" :value="key">
      {{ t(`filters.sort.${key}`) }}
    </option>
  </select>
</label>
```

- **Wiring:** Uses `useFilters()` (same composable as `ResultsSummary`, `extensions/index.vue`). The `onChange` handler calls `update({ sort: value })`, which mutates the URL via the filter composable.
- **Visual:** Compact icon + 12px select, fits a dense row.
- **Reuse:** Used only in `extensions/index.vue` (line 110). No other callers.
- **Props:** None. Fully self-contained.

**Moving it:** Zero friction. Just extract from line 110 and insert into `ResultsSummary` props or as a slot.

---

### 5. MCP Panorama Page — `/app/pages/mcp-panorama.vue`

**Full file:** 232 lines. Uses `layout: mcp-panorama` (line 11), NOT `browse`.

**Key distinctions:**
- **Layout:** `mcp-panorama.vue` layout (lines 1–28) is simpler: TopBar + main slot, no global sidebar. The page owns its own `LayerSidebar` (line 157).
- **Data model:** Calls `/api/internal/mcp-landscape` (line 28–34), which returns `LayerPayload` with `groups: Group[]` where each group has `.items` (tools) and each tool has `.mcps` (MCPs). **This is a hierarchical landscape, not a flat extension list.**
- **Dual view mode:** The page has `viewMode: "panorama" | "list"` state (line 24) with toggle in `SectionHeader`. When `list`, it renders `GroupedListView` (line 216–222), which re-renders the hierarchy as a collapsed/grouped list, not the flat `ExtGrid`.
- **Semantic difference:** The MCP Panorama is curated (organized by Sectors/Domains/PDTs, with status metadata) whereas the extensions list is marketplace-style (grid of cards, filterable by facets). They're **complementary views of the same underlying data** (MCPs), not "the same list, different layout."

**Quote (lines 204–215):**
```vue
<PanoramaView
  v-if="data && viewMode === 'panorama'"
  :stats="...computeStats(filteredGroups.flatMap((g) => g.items))"
  :groups="filteredGroups"
  ...
/>
<GroupedListView
  v-else-if="data && viewMode === 'list'"
  :layer="layer"
  :groups="filteredGroups"
  ...
/>
```

**Implication for proposal (1):** If you frame the sidebar as "View the MCP catalog in two ways — by list [extensions list, grid] vs by panorama [landscape, hierarchical]," that's accurate and clean. If you say "same data, just different layout," users may be confused when they land on panorama and find a hierarchy, not a grid. Recommend framing as "Browse MCPs" (links to `/mcp-panorama`) vs "Search MCPs" (stays on current grid).

---

### 6. TopBar Navigation — `/app/components/layout/TopBar.vue`

**Full file:** 125 lines. The navigation bar at the top.

**Current structure:**
- Logo + "Browse" link (mobile only, lines 40–45)
- Nav bar (desktop only, lines 47–109) with:
  - "Trending" link (line 51–56)
  - "Skills", "MCP Servers" links (lines 58–66) — PRIMARY_ITEMS
  - "Collections" link (lines 68–74)
  - "More" popover (lines 76–108) — slash commands, plugins
  - "Publish" icon (lines 111–119)

**MCP Panorama is not exposed.** The `/mcp-panorama` page is not linked in the main navigation. It's only reachable via:
1. The "View the MCP Panorama" link on `extensions?category=mcp` (added in commit 49b72ec)
2. Direct URL

If you move the panorama link to the sidebar, **consider also adding it to the TopBar** (e.g., as a secondary link within the "MCP Servers" section or a popover). Currently, navigation to panorama is hidden; the page exists but isn't discoverable from the main nav.

---

So calling them "List | Panorama" mildly oversells the symmetry. Your phrasing "**by types** / **by panorama**" is actually more honest because it speaks to organizing principles rather than implying the same data redrawn. ## Approved Plan:
# MCP Listing — Sidebar Peer & Sort Relocation

## Context

Follow-up pass on `app/pages/extensions/index.vue` after the prior elegance refinement (commit `49b72ec` on branch `refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion`). Two remaining issues:

1. The "View the MCP Panorama" link is still a small right-aligned anchor above the search row. The panorama itself isn't surfaced anywhere in the TopBar either, so it's effectively a hidden destination reached only via that anchor. The user wants it elevated to a **sidebar peer** when browsing MCP — framed as two browse modes ("By types" / "By panorama"), matching the user's mental model that both are ways to encounter MCP servers organized differently.

2. The `SortSelect` lives in the **search row**, where it crowds the input and implies it controls search behavior. Information-architecturally, sort describes how *results* are presented and belongs with the `ResultsSummary` row (count + active filter chips + "Clear all"). Both `ResultsSummary` and `SortSelect` are used only on this page, so the move is structurally clean.

User picked: **vertical peer links** in the sidebar (recommended option), framed as "By types" (active, current grid) and "By panorama →" (link out to `/mcp-panorama`). Honest about the panorama being a separate destination rather than a re-layout of the same data, and uses the user's own phrasing ("by types") which avoids colliding with the panorama page's internal `panorama/list` view toggle.

## Approach

**Sidebar block — `Browse MCP`:** Add a new conditional section at the *top* of `app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue`, rendered only when `route.query.category === "mcp"`. Two stacked links in the sidebar's existing visual idiom (matches the top-level l1 nav items: `text-[15px] font-semibold`, ink color when active, ink-muted otherwise):

- **By types** — active treatment, no `href` action (current page); reuses existing l1-nav styling so the active state reads naturally.
- **By panorama →** — `NuxtLink` to `localePath('/mcp-panorama')`, with the existing `ArrowUpRight` icon. This is the page's intentional accent moment — keep `text-(--color-accent)` per decision #11.

A small italic-serif heading `Browse MCP` (mirroring the existing `Categories` h2 treatment at `Sidebar.vue:32`) sits above the two links. A thin border-b separates the block from the Categories nav below.

**Inline anchor → mobile-only:** The browse-layout sidebar is `hidden md:flex` (`browse.vue:22`), so on mobile users have no sidebar. To preserve discoverability there, the existing inline anchor at `extensions/index.vue:80-88` gets `md:hidden` on its wrapper: visible on mobile, hidden on desktop where the sidebar takes over.

**Sort → ResultsSummary row:** Append `<SortSelect class="ml-auto" />` at the end of the row in `app/components/extension/ResultsSummary.vue`, after the chips/clear-all block. The existing `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2` row absorbs it; `ml-auto` pushes it to the right end when chips are absent. When chips are present, the chips div is `flex-1`, which already consumes the slack and naturally pushes SortSelect to the trailing edge. Remove `<SortSelect />` from `extensions/index.vue:110` so the search row collapses to just `[search input]`.

No new layout components, no new props on existing components — both `ResultsSummary` and `SortSelect` are single-use on this page, so the merge is local.

## Files to modify

1. **`app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue`** (95 lines) — add the conditional `Browse MCP` block above the existing `<h2>Categories</h2>` at `:32`. Pattern:
   - Show only when `route.query.category === "mcp"`.
   - Heading matches `Sidebar.vue:32` styling (`px-2 pb-1.5 font-serif text-[12px] italic tracking-wide text-(--color-ink-muted)`).
   - Two `NuxtLink`s with the existing l1 nav treatment (`Sidebar.vue:46-56` is the reference).
   - "By types" link points to the current URL with `funcCat`/`subCat`/`l2` cleared (reuse the existing `buildHref` helper at `:13-25`); it's the implicit active state since we're already on `/extensions?category=mcp`.
   - "By panorama" uses `localePath('/mcp-panorama')` directly (different route, so `buildHref` doesn't apply).
   - Trailing `border-b border-(--color-border)` + `mb-2 pb-3` to separate from Categories.

2. **`app/components/extension/ResultsSummary.vue`** (165 lines) — at the end of the row at `:138-164`, after the `hasChips` block at `:143-163`, render `<SortSelect class="ml-auto" />`. Import `SortSelect` from `~/components/filters/SortSelect.vue` (auto-imported by Nuxt, but worth flagging it'll be the first time this component reaches it).

3. **`app/pages/extensions/index.vue`** (136 lines) — two small edits:
   - Add `md:hidden` to the inline panorama anchor wrapper at `:80` (`<div v-if="isMcpCategory" class="mb-3 md:hidden flex justify-end">`).
   - Remove `<SortSelect />` from `:110` (the search row collapses to just the search form).

4. **`i18n/locales/en.json`** — add under `sidebar`:
   ```json
   "mcp": {
     "heading": "Browse MCP",
     "byTypes": "By types",
     "byPanorama": "By panorama"
   }
   ```

5. **`i18n/locales/zh.json`** — same shape:
   ```json
   "mcp": {
     "heading": "浏览 MCP",
     "byTypes": "按类型",
     "byPanorama": "按全景图"
   }
   ```

## What stays unchanged

- **Browse layout** (`app/layouts/browse.vue`) — sidebar gating (`hidden md:flex`), positioning, sticky behavior. No prop drilling needed; `Sidebar.vue` reads `route.query.category` directly, same as it already reads `funcCat`/`subCat`/`l2`.
- **TopBar** — no nav changes. The panorama remains undiscoverable from the TopBar; that's a separate UX item (call it out in the PR description but don't fix here).
- **mcp-panorama page** — no reverse-direction "back to MCP servers" link added; out of scope.
- **FilterBar**, **ExtGrid**, **ExtCard**, **SortSelect** internals — untouched.
- **Decision #3** (single-row pill rail) — preserved; the change is above (search row) and below (results row), not inside the filter rail.
- **Decision #11** (accent restraint) — the "By panorama" link keeps `text-(--color-accent)` as the page's intentional accent moment. "By types" uses neutral ink. Sort dropdown remains neutral.

## Verification

Run `bun run dev` and walk through:

1. `/en/extensions?category=mcp` on desktop (≥md) — sidebar shows `Browse MCP` block with `By types` reading as active (ink color) and `By panorama →` in accent ink with the arrow. Above the existing `Categories` heading, separated by a thin border. Inline right-aligned anchor at the top of the page area is **hidden**. Search row contains only the search input (no sort).
2. `/en/extensions?category=mcp` on mobile (<md) — sidebar hidden by the layout; inline `View the MCP Panorama →` anchor **visible** above the search row.
3. `/en/extensions?category=skills` (and `slash`, `plugins`) — no `Browse MCP` block in the sidebar; the rest of the sidebar (Categories + taxonomy) renders unchanged.
4. `/en/extensions` (no category) — same as the skills case (no MCP block).
5. Click `By panorama` — navigates to `/en/mcp-panorama`. Locale prefix preserved.
6. On `/en/extensions?category=mcp`, run a search or apply a tag filter — the results row reads `Showing 42 — [chip] [chip] [Clear all] ............ [Sort ⌄]`, with sort pushed to the right. Narrow the viewport until it wraps; sort should drop to a second line gracefully (`flex-wrap` already in place at `ResultsSummary.vue:138`).
7. `/zh/extensions?category=mcp` — Chinese labels: `浏览 MCP`, `按类型`, `按全景图`. Click `按全景图` → `/zh/mcp-panorama`.
8. Theme cycle (Editorial Ivory, Dark, Mono Clean) — sidebar block legible in each. The `By panorama` accent reads correctly per theme. Sort dropdown unchanged.
9. `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test` — all green; no new diagnostics.

## Branch & commit

Continue on the existing branch `refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion` (already off latest `origin/main`, 1 commit ahead). This is the same cohesion pass, so it stacks naturally.

Suggested commit message:
```
refactor(extensions): lift MCP panorama to a sidebar peer; move sort to results row

Sidebar now shows a small "Browse MCP" block when category=mcp, with two
peer links — "By types" (current grid) and "By panorama →" (link to the
landscape view). The inline panorama anchor is retained on mobile only,
where the sidebar is hidden.

SortSelect moves out of the search row and onto the "Showing X" results
row, alongside the active filter chips and Clear all — sort describes how
results are presented, not how to search.
```

No PR push from this turn unless requested.

## Out of scope (flag in PR description)

- Adding the panorama to the TopBar — separate UX work; the sidebar block + mobile inline anchor cover the listing entry, but a global TopBar entry remains absent.
- A reverse-direction nav element on `/mcp-panorama` linking back to the by-types listing — symmetric but separate.
- Any refactor of `ResultsSummary` to make the row reusable elsewhere — both `ResultsSummary` and `SortSelect` are single-use today, so the inline merge is honest about that.

```

Perfect. Now I have a comprehensive understanding. Let me compile my findings:

## Architecture Summary

**Current State: Panorama as a Separate Page**

1. **Dedicated Layout** — `/app/layouts/mcp-panorama.vue` is a minimal layout with only TopBar + main slot. It explicitly omits the aside/sidebar to let the panorama page own the sidebar via `LayerSidebar.vue`.

2. **Page-Owned Sidebar** — The panorama sidebar (`LayerSidebar.vue`, 268px wide) is rendered *inside* the page (`mcp-panorama.vue`) as the first element, paired with the main content area using a three-column grid layout: sidebar | main | detail panel.

3. **Sidebar Structure** — `LayerSidebar.vue` is tightly coupled to panorama state: it receives `layer`, `groups`, drill state (`activePrimary`/`activeSecondary`), and emits back `update:layer` and `setActive` events. No reusability for the browse sidebar.

4. **Browse Layout Sidebar** — `/app/layouts/browse.vue` includes a fixed-width sidebar (240px) via a global `<Sidebar />` component that reads URL query params (`funcCat`, `subCat`, `l2`) and renders FUNC_TAXONOMY categories. The sidebar is static and has a "Browse MCP" section with two pills: "By types" (current page link) and "By panorama" (external link to `/mcp-panorama`).

5. **Data & State** — Panorama fetches from `/api/internal/mcp-landscape?layer=X`, receives a `LayerPayload` with groups/tools/MCPs, and manages state locally: `layer`, `activePrimary`, `activeSecondary`, `statusFilter`, `viewMode`, `active` (detail panel). The browse page has separate URL-driven filter state.

6. **Main View Components** — Panorama renders `PanoramaView` (grid of sector/domain cards) or `GroupedListView` (tabular list view) based on `viewMode`. Both are responsive and layout-driven; the grid uses `minmax(520px, 1fr)` for public and `minmax(320px, 1fr)` for industry.

7. **Detail Panel** — Rendered as a third column (right side) via `ToolDetailPanel`. State-driven by `active` ref; appears/disappears with the selected MCP.

8. **Header & Filters** — `SectionHeader.vue` displays the title, drill breadcrumb, status filter chips, and view mode toggle. It's separate from the sidebar and always visible above the main content.

---

## File-by-File Findings

### 1. `/app/pages/mcp-panorama.vue` (232 lines)

**Key state variables:**
- `layer` (ref): "public" | "industry" — which service layer to display
- `activePrimary` (ref): string | null — selected sector/domain key (drill-down)
- `activeSecondary` (ref): string | null — selected PDT key (public layer only)
- `statusFilter` (ref): "all" | McpStatus — filter by released/dev/none
- `viewMode` (ref): "panorama" | "list" — grid or table view
- `active` (ref): {tool, mcp} | null — which MCP card is selected for the detail panel

**Data fetching:**
- Single `useFetch("/api/internal/mcp-landscape", { query: { layer }, key: "mcp-landscape" })`
- Refetches when `layer` changes; all other filtering is client-side

**Event handlers:**
- `setActive(primary, secondary)` — sets drill-down state
- `clearDrill()` — resets drill to root
- `pickMcp(payload)` — sets the detail panel's active MCP
- `drillTo(primary)` — navigates to a specific sector/domain
- `filterTo(status)` — toggles status filter
- Watch on `layer` resets drill state

**Children imported:**
- `LayerSidebar` — renders inside page
- `SectionHeader`, `PanoramaView`, `GroupedListView`, `ToolDetailPanel` — from mcp-landscape

---

### 2. `/app/layouts/mcp-panorama.vue` (29 lines)

**Structure:** TopBar + main slot. No sidebar slot; deliberately omits the global aside.

**Design note:** "The MCP Panorama page renders its own LayerSidebar inside <main>; this layout omits the global aside slot so the page-owned sidebar owns the gutter."

---

### 3. `/app/layouts/browse.vue` (36 lines)

**Structure:**
```html
<div class="flex flex-col">
  <header>TopBar</header>
  <div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl flex">
    <aside class="w-[240px]">
      <Sidebar />
    </aside>
    <main class="flex-1">
      <slot />
    </main>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Key differences:**
- Fixed 240px sidebar (narrower than panorama's 268px)
- Hidden on mobile (md:flex)
- Sticky positioning (sticky top-16)
- Global `<Sidebar />` component, not page-owned

---

### 4. `/app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue` (119 lines)

**Two sections:**
1. **MCP section** (lines 33–54) — Appears when `route.query.category === "mcp"`:
   - "By types" pill (current link, no href)
   - "By panorama" pill (link to `/mcp-panorama` with ArrowUpRight icon)

2. **Categories section** (lines 56–116) — FUNC_TAXONOMY tree:
   - "All categories" link
   - Expandable category → L1 subcategories → L2 leaf items
   - Uses URL query params: `funcCat`, `subCat`, `l2`
   - Styled with category colors from `FUNC_CAT_COLORS`

**State:** Entirely URL-driven via `useRoute()` and `buildHref()` helper.

---

### 5. `/app/components/mcp-landscape/LayerSidebar.vue` (207 lines)

**Props:**
- `layer: Layer`
- `groups: Group[]`
- `totalCount: number`
- `activePrimary: string | null`
- `activeSecondary: string | null`

**Emits:**
- `update:layer` — when layer button clicked
- `setActive` — (primary, secondary) when a sector/domain/PDT selected

**Structure:**
- **Top section** (lines 71–120): Layer toggle buttons (Industry/Public) with icons and descriptions. Fixed height, styled with layer-specific colors.
- **Middle section** (lines 123–196): Scrollable tree of sectors or domains+PDTs:
  - "All MCPs" button at top
  - Industry layer: flat list of sectors (no children)
  - Public layer: expandable domains with nested PDT buttons
  - Counts shown for each node
- **Footer** (lines 199–205): Sparkles icon + "Push to MCP" hint text

**Coupling:** Tightly coupled to panorama page state. Requires `groups` array with full shape; emits back to parent for state mutations. Not designed to work standalone.

**Width:** Hardcoded `w-[268px]` — incompatible with browse sidebar's 240px, would overflow.

---

### 6. `/app/components/mcp-landscape/` Directory

All 16 files in this folder:

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `LayerSidebar.vue` | Panorama's drill-down sidebar; industry/public layer toggle; sector/domain/PDT tree |
| `SectionHeader.vue` | Title, breadcrumb, status filter chips, view mode toggle (panorama/list) |
| `PanoramaView.vue` | Grid layout renderer; composes SectorCard and DomainCard |
| `LayerSummary.vue` | Summary stats card (top of main area): activation %, counts, top-3 groups by release % |
| `GroupedListView.vue` | Tabular view: groups organized by domain/PDT, 3-column status buckets per group |
| `SectorCard.vue` | Card for a single sector; contains ToolMcpsCard rows |
| `DomainCard.vue` | Card for a single domain; contains nested PdtBlock columns |
| `PdtBlock.vue` | Column within a DomainCard; lists tools in a PDT |
| `ToolMcpsCard.vue` | Tool + its MCPs (one row per tool, multiple MCP tiles per row) |
| `McpTile.vue` | Individual MCP tile (name, status, icon, click handler) |
| `CardHeader.vue` | Group card header (title, rank badge) |
| `ToolDetailPanel.vue` | Slide-in right panel showing selected MCP details, dependencies, marketplace link |
| `StatusChip.vue` | Filter button showing status label + count |
| `StatusPill.vue` | Small inline status indicator (released/dev/none) |
| `ToolCard.vue` | List-view card for a tool+MCP pair |
| `McpTile.nuxt.test.ts` | Test file |

---

### 7. `/server/api/internal/mcp-landscape.get.ts` (16 lines)

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/internal/mcp-landscape?layer=public|industry`

**Response:** `LayerPayload` containing:
```typescript
{
  layer: "public" | "industry"
  layerStats: GroupStats {
    total: number
    counts: { released, dev, none }
    releasedPct, activePct, lagPct: number
  }
  groups: Group[] // SectorGroup[] or DomainGroup[]
}
```

**Implementation:** Delegates to `getLandscape(layer)` from `server/utils/queries/mcp-landscape.ts`.

---

### 8. `/shared/mcp-panorama.ts` (146 lines)

**Exported types:**
- `Layer = "industry" | "public"`
- `McpDto` — single MCP server (id, slug, name, status, depsCount, blurb, tags, extensionSlug, isPlaceholder)
- `ToolDto` — product owning MCPs (id, slug, name, ownerPrimary, ownerSecondary, mcps[], rollupStatus)
- `GroupStats` — counts and percentages (total, released, dev, none, releasedPct, activePct, lagPct)
- `PdtBlock` — PDT group (key, label/labelZh, items: ToolDto[])
- `SectorGroup` — industry group (kind: "sector", key, label/labelZh, short, items, stats)
- `DomainGroup` — public group (kind: "domain", key, label/labelZh, short, items, pdts: PdtBlock[], stats)
- `Group = SectorGroup | DomainGroup`
- `LayerPayload` — API response shape
- `RankKey = "leading" | "onTrack" | "lagging" | "early"`

**Utility functions:**
- `rankFor(stats)` — derive rank label from stats
- `groupDisplayTitle(g, locale)` — localized group name
- `pdtDisplayTitle(p, locale)` — localized PDT name
- `toolDisplayName/Blurb`, `mcpDisplayName/Blurb` — localized display strings

- `rollupStatus(statuses)` — "released wins" logic for tool-level status

## Friction Points

**1. Sidebar Width Mismatch**
- LayerSidebar is 268px; browse Sidebar is 240px
- Cannot simply swap LayerSidebar into browse layout without resizing
- Responsive behavior differs: panorama sidebar is always visible; browse sidebar is `hidden md:flex`

**2. Drill State is Page-Local**
- Panorama's `activePrimary`, `activeSecondary`, `statusFilter`, `viewMode` are refs on the page
- Browse page uses URL query params for all state (funcCat, subCat, l2, filters)
- Switching between views would require choosing: URL persistence or local state loss
- Swapping views on the same physical page means drill state reset on tab switch

**3. Sidebar is Tightly Coupled to Data Structure**
- LayerSidebar expects `groups: Group[]` shaped by the MCP landscape
- Browse Sidebar reads FUNC_TAXONOMY (a static, separate taxonomy)
- Can't have a sidebar that adapts both taxonomies without conditional rendering or major refactor

**4. Footer Slot Not Available in Browse Layout**
- LayerSidebar has a fixed footer ("Push to MCP" hint)
- Browse Sidebar doesn't have reserved footer space; it's just scrollable content
- Panorama footer would need a new mechanism if rendered in browse layout

**5. Data Fetching Differs Significantly**
- Panorama: single `useFetch("/api/internal/mcp-landscape?layer=X")`, refetch on layer change
- Browse: composite `useFetch("/api/internal/extensions", { query: route.query })`, separate `useFetch("/api/internal/facets")`
- Unifying means deciding: do both views call both endpoints? Or conditionally fetch?

**6. Header Section Tightly Coupled to Panorama State**
- `SectionHeader.vue` expects `activePrimary`, `activeSecondary`, `statusFilter`, `viewMode`, `visibleCounts`, `groups` as props
- All of these are local state on the panorama page
- If moving to browse layout, these refs would need to live on the page or be lifted to URL query params
- Changes to filter/drill would need to update URL if they're to persist across navigation

## Approved Plan:
# MCP Listing × Panorama — Unified Chrome

## Context

After the prior pass (PR #36 — sidebar peer + sort relocation), the user observed two remaining cohesion issues:

1. **`/mcp-panorama` doesn't look or behave like a peer of `/extensions?category=mcp`.** It uses a dedicated layout (`app/layouts/mcp-panorama.vue`), renders its own embedded `LayerSidebar` in a 3-column grid, and feels like a separate destination rather than a sibling view.
2. **The "By panorama" link in the Sidebar is styled as an external/secondary action** (accent color + `ArrowUpRight` icon), reinforcing "you are leaving."

The user's intent: treat the two as **peer modes of one experience**. Both should share the same chrome (browse layout, TopBar, the global `Sidebar`'s top half), and the sidebar's **bottom half** should swap between Categories (FUNC_TAXONOMY, for the list view) and the panorama's own taxonomy (layer toggle + sector/domain drill tree). The pills become equal-weight and URL-aware — the active one is non-clickable, the inactive one cross-navigates to its peer route.

URL strategy: **two routes, shared chrome** (confirmed). Each route owns its own data fetching; the global Sidebar adapts based on which route is active.

## Approach

**Pills become equal-weight and URL-aware.** Remove the accent color + `ArrowUpRight` from "By panorama" in `Sidebar.vue`. Both pills render in the same neutral idiom; the active one is a `<span aria-current="page">` (non-clickable), the inactive one is a `NuxtLink` to its peer route. Active-detection: `route.path` ends with `/mcp-panorama` → "By panorama" active; otherwise "By types" active (only shown when `route.query.category === "mcp"` on the extensions route).

**Panorama page adopts the browse layout.** Change `definePageMeta({ layout: "mcp-panorama" })` to `{ layout: "browse" }` in `app/pages/mcp-panorama.vue`. The page no longer embeds `LayerSidebar`; instead, the global `Sidebar` (already rendered by `browse.vue`) handles the left-rail content. The page's main column becomes `SectionHeader → PanoramaView | GroupedListView → ToolDetailPanel`, padded to match `extensions/index.vue`'s `px-6 py-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto`.

**`Sidebar.vue` adapts its bottom section based on route.** Above the bottom section is the existing "Browse MCP" block (shown whenever the user is in MCP mode — either `/extensions?category=mcp` or `/mcp-panorama`). Below it:
- On `/extensions` → existing Categories / FUNC_TAXONOMY tree (unchanged).
- On `/mcp-panorama` → new `PanoramaSidebarSection.vue` containing the compact layer toggle and drill tree (extracted from the current `LayerSidebar.vue` middle section, restyled to fit 240px).

**Panorama state lifts to URL query params.** The page-local refs (`layer`, `activePrimary`, `activeSecondary`, `statusFilter`, `viewMode`) become URL-driven via a new composable `usePanoramaState()`. This is required because `Sidebar.vue` is a sibling of the page — it can't read page refs. URL schema:
```
/mcp-panorama?layer=industry&primary=<key>&secondary=<key>&status=released&view=list
```
Defaults: `layer=public`, `primary=null`, `secondary=null`, `status=all`, `view=panorama`. The `active` detail-panel state stays local (ephemeral interaction state, doesn't belong in the URL).

**Mobile.** The browse layout's sidebar is `hidden md:flex`. To keep the panorama controls reachable on mobile, the panorama page adds a compact top-of-main control rail (`md:hidden`) with: layer pills, status pills, view toggle, and a collapsible drill-tree popover. This mirrors the prior pass's pattern (mobile keeps an inline panorama-link anchor when the sidebar is hidden).

**Visual unification.** Panorama page wrapper adopts the same outer container as the listing (`px-6 py-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto`). `SectionHeader`'s typography aligns with the rest of the app (Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for counts). Per decision #11 (accent restraint), the unified Sidebar has no accent ink in either mode; the only accent moments stay focus rings and the home featured hero.

## Files to modify

### Move / restructure

1. **`app/pages/mcp-panorama.vue`** (232 lines)
   - Swap `definePageMeta({ layout: "mcp-panorama" })` for `{ layout: "browse" }`.
   - Replace the local refs (`layer`, `activePrimary`, `activeSecondary`, `statusFilter`, `viewMode`) with the new `usePanoramaState()` composable. Keep `active` (the detail panel) local.
   - Drop the `<LayerSidebar>` render from the template; the global `Sidebar` now owns the left rail.
   - Wrap main content in `<div class="px-6 py-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto">` to match the listing.
   - Add a mobile-only control rail above `<SectionHeader>` rendering compact layer / status / view / drill controls (see "Mobile" above).
   - `<ToolDetailPanel>` becomes a fixed-position slide-in drawer anchored to the viewport (currently a 3rd grid column). Use `fixed inset-y-0 right-0` with a backdrop on mobile.

2. **`app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue`** (current ~119 lines)
   - Remove the `ArrowUpRight` import and the accent color from the "By panorama" link.
   - Make both pills URL-aware: derive `isTypesActive` and `isPanoramaActive` from `route.path`. The active one renders as `<span aria-current="page">` (neutral ink); the inactive one renders as `NuxtLink` (neutral ink, hover bg).
   - Show the "Browse MCP" block whenever in MCP mode — either `route.query.category === "mcp"` (list view) **or** the route is `/mcp-panorama`.
   - Conditionally render the bottom section: existing FUNC_TAXONOMY block when on `/extensions`, new `PanoramaSidebarSection` when on `/mcp-panorama`.
   - Remove the FUNC_TAXONOMY block when on `/mcp-panorama` (it doesn't apply there).

3. **`app/layouts/mcp-panorama.vue`** — delete. The browse layout now hosts the panorama page.

### New files

4. **`app/composables/usePanoramaState.ts`** (new, ~60 lines)
   - Exports `{ layer, primary, secondary, status, viewMode, setLayer, setDrill, clearDrill, setStatus, setView }`.
   - Reads from `route.query` (string-typed; falls back to defaults).
   - Writes back via `router.push({ query: { ...current, ... } })` to keep behavior consistent with `useFilters()`.
   - When `setLayer` changes the layer, it also clears `primary`/`secondary` (matches the current `watch(layer, …)` behavior at `mcp-panorama.vue:36-40`).

5. **`app/components/mcp-landscape/PanoramaSidebarSection.vue`** (new, ~150 lines)
   - Reads state from `usePanoramaState()`.
   - Receives `groups: Group[]` and `totalCount: number` as props (so it can render counts and the drill tree). Parent (`Sidebar.vue`) sources these from a shared `useNuxtData("mcp-landscape")` lookup — same key as the page's `useFetch`.
   - Top: compact layer toggle (two horizontal pills, ~36px tall) — Public | Industry. Active state uses neutral bg + ink, matching the existing taxonomy nav idiom.
   - Middle: drill tree (sectors for industry; domains + PDTs for public). Styled to fit 240px — reduce the current `LayerSidebar`'s padding and indent. Counts in `font-mono text-[11px]`.
   - Drop the footer ("Push to MCP" sparkles hint) — marketing chrome that doesn't fit the unified sidebar; the equivalent CTA can live as a small link at the bottom of the page main area if needed (out of scope here).

### Adapt

6. **`app/components/mcp-landscape/LayerSidebar.vue`** — keep for now but mark for removal once `PanoramaSidebarSection` covers all use cases. If no callers remain after the page refactor, delete in the same commit.

7. **`app/components/mcp-landscape/SectionHeader.vue`** — read state from `usePanoramaState()` directly instead of props, so the page doesn't have to thread state through. Keep prop API as a fallback if used elsewhere.

8. **`app/components/extension/ResultsSummary.vue`** — unchanged structurally; just confirm SortSelect placement still works (it should).

9. **`i18n/locales/en.json` / `zh.json`** — `mcpPanorama.*` keys already exist; reuse them. May need to add a couple of mobile-rail labels (`mcpPanorama.mobile.drillToggle` or similar) — minimal additions.

10. **`app/components/layout/TopBar.vue`** — no change. Panorama remains undiscoverable from the top nav; that's a separate UX item (out of scope, called out).

## State migration map (panorama page → URL)

| Today (page refs) | Tomorrow (URL query) |
| --- | --- |
| `layer: ref<Layer>("public")` | `?layer=public\|industry` |
| `activePrimary: ref<string\|null>(null)` | `?primary=<key>` (absent → null) |
| `activeSecondary: ref<string\|null>(null)` | `?secondary=<key>` (absent → null) |
| `statusFilter: ref<"all"\|McpStatus>("all")` | `?status=all\|none\|dev\|released` |
| `viewMode: ref<"panorama"\|"list">("panorama")` | `?view=panorama\|list` |
| `active: ref<{tool,mcp}\|null>(null)` | stays local — ephemeral panel state |

## What stays unchanged

- Browse layout structure (`browse.vue` aside + sticky positioning) — `Sidebar` is the only component to evolve.
- `FilterBar`, `ExtGrid`, `ExtCard`, `SortSelect`, `ResultsSummary` — the list view is untouched by this pass.
- The `/api/internal/mcp-landscape` API contract.
- Panorama main-view components: `PanoramaView`, `GroupedListView`, `SectorCard`, `DomainCard`, `PdtBlock`, `ToolMcpsCard`, `McpTile`, `CardHeader`, `StatusChip`, `StatusPill`, `ToolCard`. They get state injected from `usePanoramaState()` instead of from page refs, but their templates don't change.
- The TopBar.
- Decision #3 (single-row pill rail FilterBar) — list view is untouched.
- Decision #11 (accent restraint) — the unified Sidebar carries **no** accent ink in either mode; the page's intentional accent moments are limited to focus rings and the home featured hero.

## Mobile handling

- The sidebar block is hidden on `<md` (same as the existing browse sidebar). The user does not see the Browse MCP pills or the panorama drill tree on mobile.
- The listing's existing `md:hidden` inline "View the MCP Panorama" anchor (from PR #36) stays as the entry point on mobile.
- On `/mcp-panorama` mobile, render a compact control rail above `SectionHeader`:
  - Row 1: layer pills (Public / Industry) + view toggle (Panorama / List)
  - Row 2: status pills (All / Released / Dev / None)
  - Row 3: "Browse by domain ▾" disclosure that expands the drill tree inline (collapses by default).
- All these controls write to the same `usePanoramaState()` composable used by the desktop sidebar — single source of truth.

## Verification

Run `bun run dev`, then walk through:

1. **Desktop `/en/extensions?category=mcp`** — Sidebar: Browse MCP pills (By types active = neutral, non-clickable; By panorama inactive = neutral, NuxtLink to `/en/mcp-panorama`). Bottom: FUNC_TAXONOMY Categories. Main: list grid + filters.
2. **Click "By panorama"** — URL becomes `/en/mcp-panorama`. No layout shift / chrome flicker. Sidebar: pills swap (panorama active, types inactive). Bottom: panorama controls (layer toggle + drill tree). Main: panorama view with the same outer container padding as the list view.
3. **Click "By types"** from `/en/mcp-panorama` — return to `/en/extensions?category=mcp`. Sidebar bottom swaps back to FUNC_TAXONOMY.
4. **Drill on the panorama sidebar** — click a sector → URL updates to `?primary=…`. `SectionHeader` breadcrumb updates. Browser back works.
5. **Layer toggle** — click Industry on `/mcp-panorama?layer=public&primary=…` → URL becomes `?layer=industry` (primary cleared). Data refetches; drill tree re-renders.
6. **Status filter** — click Released → URL updates to `?status=released`. Filtered counts update everywhere (sidebar tree + main view + section header).
7. **View toggle** — click List → URL updates to `?view=list`. Main renders `GroupedListView`. Click Panorama → reverts.
8. **Detail panel** — click an MCP tile → ToolDetailPanel slides in from the right (fixed position drawer). Close → drawer disappears. State (drill, filters) preserved.
9. **`/en/extensions?category=skills`** — no Browse MCP block in the sidebar; FUNC_TAXONOMY renders as before. Sanity check on non-MCP routes.
10. **Mobile** (`<md` viewport): On `/en/extensions?category=mcp` the inline "View the MCP Panorama" anchor is visible (from PR #36). On `/en/mcp-panorama` the compact top-of-main control rail renders. Drill disclosure expands inline. Detail panel becomes a fullscreen overlay.
11. **`/zh/mcp-panorama`** — Chinese labels render across the sidebar and the control rail.
12. **Theme cycle** (Editorial Ivory / Dark / Mono Clean) — both routes legible across themes; no accent ink in the sidebar.
13. **Bookmarks / back / share** — share a URL like `/en/mcp-panorama?layer=industry&primary=wireless&status=released&view=list` → reload renders that exact state.
14. **Tests + checks** — `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test` all green. `McpTile.nuxt.test.ts` still passes (no behavioral change to McpTile itself).

## Out of scope (flag in PR description)

- **Panorama in TopBar.** The unified sidebar block + mobile rail cover entry from `/extensions?category=mcp`, but the panorama is still not surfaced in the TopBar. Separate UX work.
- **Replacing the detail panel with navigation to `/extensions/[slug]`.** The list view uses card-to-detail navigation; the panorama keeps the side panel for the side-by-side affordance. Could converge later.
- **Visual restyle of SectionHeader.** Kept structurally as-is. A typographic pass to align with the listing's `font-mono text-[12px]` count idiom is a follow-up.
- **Deleting the old `LayerSidebar.vue` immediately.** Marked for removal once `PanoramaSidebarSection` proves equivalent; deletion deferred to a follow-up commit to keep this PR scoped.
- **Reverse-direction discoverability from `/mcp-panorama` back to a "browse by types" CTA.** The sidebar pills cover it on desktop; mobile relies on the top-of-main rail.

## Branch & commit

This work depends on PR #36 (the Browse MCP block is the entry point). Two reasonable paths:

1. **Stack on the existing branch** — keep adding commits to `refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion` so PR #36 grows to cover the full cohesion pass. Simpler, but the diff balloons.
2. **New branch off `refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion`** — e.g. `refactor/mcp-unified-chrome`. Open a stacked PR pointing at the existing branch. Cleaner review surface; #36 lands first.

Recommend (2). Suggested commit sequence (one per coherent unit per CLAUDE.md §13):
- `refactor(mcp-panorama): lift page state to URL via usePanoramaState composable`
- `refactor(mcp-panorama): adopt browse layout; drop the dedicated mcp-panorama layout`
- `refactor(sidebar): extract PanoramaSidebarSection; conditional rendering by route`
- `refactor(sidebar): equal-weight pills; remove accent + ArrowUpRight from "By panorama"`
- `feat(mcp-panorama): mobile control rail for the sidebar-less viewport`

Each commit should typecheck + test cleanly so the branch is bisectable.

## Size & risk

This is a substantial refactor — likely **300-500 net new/changed lines** across ~8 files plus 2 new files. The riskiest part is the state lift (page refs → URL composable); the rest is structural rearrangement. If scope feels too large, two clean cut points exist:

- **Cut after commit 2** (panorama under browse layout, embedded `LayerSidebar` still rendered in main): functional but awkward — sidebar is empty/Categories while LayerSidebar still occupies main. Not recommended as a ship point.
- **Cut after commit 3** (PanoramaSidebarSection live, but pills still styled as link + arrow): the visual asymmetry remains. Could ship but the user's specific ask (equal pills) isn't fully delivered.

Recommend shipping the full sequence.

65	  if (!data.value) return []
66	  function filterTools(tools: ToolDto[]): ToolDto[] {
67	    return tools
68	      .filter(inDrill)
69	      .map((tool) => ({
70	        ...tool,
71	        mcps: tool.mcps.filter(passesStatus),
72	      }))
73	      .filter((tool) => tool.mcps.length > 0)
74	  }
75	  return data.value.groups
76	    .map((g): Group => {
77	      const items = filterTools(g.items)
78	      if (g.kind === "sector") {
79	        return { ...g, items, stats: computeStats(items) }
80	      }
81	      const pdts = g.pdts
82	        .map((p) => ({ ...p, items: filterTools(p.items) }))
83	        .filter((p) => p.items.length > 0)
84	      return { ...g, items, pdts, stats: computeStats(items) }
85	    })
86	    .filter((g) => g.items.length > 0)
87	})
88	
89	function computeStats(items: ToolDto[]) {
90	  const counts = { released: 0, dev: 0, none: 0 }
91	  let total = 0
92	  for (const t of items) {
93	    for (const m of t.mcps) {
94	      counts[m.status]++
95	      total++
96	    }
97	  }
98	  if (total === 0) {
99	    return { total, counts, releasedPct: 0, activePct: 0, lagPct: 0 }
100	  }
101	  return {
102	    total,
103	    counts,
104	    releasedPct: Math.round((counts.released / total) * 100),
105	    activePct: Math.round(((counts.released + counts.dev) / total) * 100),
106	    lagPct: Math.round((counts.none / total) * 100),
107	  }
108	}
109	
110	// Visible counts for the section header subtitle and filter chips. These
111	// reflect drill-down but ignore the status filter — chips show how many
112	// MCPs each status would surface if selected.
113	const visibleCounts = computed(() => {
114	  const counts = { released: 0, dev: 0, none: 0, total: 0 }
115	  for (const { tool, mcp } of allMcps.value) {
116	    if (!inDrill(tool)) continue
117	    counts[mcp.status]++
118	    counts.total++
119	  }
120	  return counts
121	})
122	
123	const totals = computed(() => ({ total: data.value?.layerStats.total ?? 0 }))
124	
125	function setActive(primary: string | null, secondary: string | null) {
126	  activePrimary.value = primary
127	  activeSecondary.value = secondary
128	  active.value = null
129	}
130	
131	function clearDrill() {
132	  activePrimary.value = null
133	  activeSecondary.value = null
134	}
135	
136	function pickMcp(payload: { tool: ToolDto; mcp: McpDto }) {
137	  active.value = payload
138	}
139	
140	function drillTo(primary: string) {
141	  activePrimary.value = primary
142	  activeSecondary.value = null
143	  active.value = null
144	}
145	
146	function filterTo(status: McpStatus) {
147	  // Same toggle behavior as the StatusChip buttons in SectionHeader —
148	  // clicking the active status flips back to "all".
149	  statusFilter.value = statusFilter.value === status ? "all" : status
150	}
151	</script>
152	
153	<template>
154	  <div class="contents">
155	    <!-- Sidebar -->
156	    <ClientOnly>
157	    <LayerSidebar
158	      v-if="data"
159	      :layer="layer"

169	    </template>

171

174	    <SectionHeader

178	      :active-secondary="activeSecondary"
179	      :visible-counts="visibleCounts"
180	      :totals="totals"

182	      :view-mode="viewMode"
183	      :groups="data.groups"
184	      @update:status-filter="(v: 'all' | McpStatus) => (statusFilter = v)"
185	      @update:view-mode="(v: 'panorama' | 'list') => (viewMode = v)"
186	      @clear-drill="clearDrill"

1	import {
2	  parseFilters,
3	  searchParamsToInput,
4	  serializeFilters,
5	  type Filters,
6	} from "~~/shared/validators/filters"
7	
8	export type FilterUpdate = Partial<Filters>
9	
10	export function useFilters() {
11	  const route = useRoute()
12	  const router = useRouter()
13	  const localePath = useLocalePath()
14	
15	  const filters = computed<Filters>(() => {
16	    const params = new URLSearchParams()
17	    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(route.query)) {
18	      if (Array.isArray(v)) {
19	        for (const item of v) if (item !== null) params.append(k, String(item))
20	      } else if (v !== null && v !== undefined) {
21	        params.append(k, String(v))
22	      }
23	    }
24	    return parseFilters(searchParamsToInput(params))
25	  })
26	
27	  function update(partial: FilterUpdate) {
28	    const next: FilterUpdate = { ...filters.value, ...partial }
29	    if (!("page" in partial)) next.page = undefined
30	    const params = serializeFilters(next)
31	    const qs = params.toString()
32	    const path = route.path
33	    router.replace(qs ? `${path}?${qs}` : path)
34	  }
35	
36	  function hrefForFilters(partial: FilterUpdate, basePath = "/extensions") {
37	    const next: FilterUpdate = { ...filters.value, ...partial }
38	    if (!("page" in partial)) next.page = undefined
39	    const params = serializeFilters(next)
40	    const qs = params.toString()
41	    const path = localePath(basePath)
42	    return qs ? `${path}?${qs}` : path
43	  }
44	
45	  return { filters, update, hrefForFilters }
46	}
47
