(value as T[number]) : fallback\n}\n\nfunction parseString(value: unknown): string | null {\n  return typeof value === \"string\" && value.length > 0 ? value : null\n}\n\nexport function usePanoramaState() {\n  const route = useRoute()\n  const router = useRouter()\n\n  const layer = computed<Layer>(() => parseEnum(route.query.layer, LAYERS, \"public\"))\n  const primary = computed<string | null>(() => parseString(route.query.primary))\n  const secondary = computed<string | null>(() => parseString(route.query.secondary))\n  const status = computed<StatusFilter>(() => parseEnum(route.query.status, STATUSES, \"all\"))\n  const viewMode = computed<ViewMode>(() => parseEnum(route.query.view, VIEWS, \"panorama\"))\n\n  function push(partial: Record<string, string | null>) {\n    const next: Record<string, string> = {}\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(route.query)) {\n      if (typeof v === \"string\") next[k] = v\n    }\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(partial)) {\n      if (v === null) delete next[k]\n      else next[k] = v\n    }\n    router.replace({ path: route.path, query: next })\n  }\n\n  function setLayer(value: Layer) {\n    push({ layer: value === \"public\" ? null : value, primary: null, secondary: null })\n  }\n\n  function setDrill(primaryKey: string | null, secondaryKey: string | null = null) {\n    push({ primary: primaryKey, secondary: secondaryKey })\n  }\n\n  function clearDrill() {\n    push({ primary: null, secondary: null })\n  }\n\n  function setStatus(value: StatusFilter) {\n    push({ status: value === \"all\" ? null : value })\n  }\n\n  function toggleStatus(value: McpStatus) {\n    push({ status: status.value === value ? null : value })\n  }\n\n  function setView(value: ViewMode) {\n    push({ view: value === \"panorama\" ? null : value })\n  }\n\n  return {\n    layer,\n    primary,\n    secondary,\n    status,\n    viewMode,\n    setLayer,\n    setDrill,\n    clearDrill,\n    setStatus,\n    toggleStatus,\n    setView,\n  }\n}\n"

91	        .map((p) => ({ ...p, items: filterTools(p.items) }))
92	        .filter((p) => p.items.length > 0)
93	      return { ...g, items, pdts, stats: computeStats(items) }
94	    })
95	    .filter((g) => g.items.length > 0)
96	})
97	
98	function computeStats(items: ToolDto[]) {
99	  const counts = { released: 0, dev: 0, none: 0 }
100	  let total = 0
101	  for (const t of items) {
102	    for (const m of t.mcps) {
103	      counts[m.status]++
104	      total++
105	    }
106	  }
107	  if (total === 0) {
108	    return { total, counts, releasedPct: 0, activePct: 0, lagPct: 0 }
109	  }
110	  return {
111	    total,
112	    counts,
113	    releasedPct: Math.round((counts.released / total) * 100),
114	    activePct: Math.round(((counts.released + counts.dev) / total) * 100),
115	    lagPct: Math.round((counts.none / total) * 100),
116	  }
117	}
118	
119	// Visible counts for the section header subtitle and filter chips. These
120	// reflect drill-down but ignore the status filter — chips show how many
121	// MCPs each status would surface if selected.
122	const visibleCounts = computed(() => {
123	  const counts = { released: 0, dev: 0, none: 0, total: 0 }
124	  for (const { tool, mcp } of allMcps.value) {
125	    if (!inDrill(tool)) continue
126	    counts[mcp.status]++
127	    counts.total++
128	  }
129	  return counts
130	})
131	
132	const totals = computed(() => ({ total: data.value?.layerStats.total ?? 0 }))
133	
134	function setActive(primary: string | null, secondary: string | null) {
135	  setDrill(primary, secondary)
136	  active.value = null
137	}
138	
139	function pickMcp(payload: { tool: ToolDto; mcp: McpDto }) {
140	  active.value = payload
141	}
142	
143	function drillTo(primary: string) {
144	  setDrill(primary, null)
145	  active.value = null
146	}
147	
148	function filterTo(status: McpStatus) {
149	  // Same toggle behavior as the StatusChip buttons in SectionHeader —
150	  // clicking the active status flips back to "all".
151	  toggleStatus(status)
152	}
153	</script>
154	
155	<template>
156	  <div class="contents">
157	    <!-- Sidebar -->
158	    <ClientOnly>
159	    <LayerSidebar
160	      v-if="data"
161	      :layer="layer"
162	      :groups="data.groups"
163	      :total-count="totals.total"
164	      :active-primary="activePrimary"
165	      :active-secondary="activeSecondary"
166	      @update:layer="setLayer"
167	      @set-active="setActive"
168	    />
169	    <template #fallback>
170	      <div class="w-[268px] shrink-0 border-r border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-sidebar)" />
171	    </template>
172	  </ClientOnly>
173	
174	  <!-- Main + side panel -->
175	  <div class="flex-1 overflow-auto bg-(--color-bg) relative">
176	    <SectionHeader
177	      v-if="data"
178	      :layer="layer"
179	      :active-primary="activePrimary"
180	      :active-secondary="activeSecondary"
181	      :visible-counts="visibleCounts"
182	      :totals="totals"
183	      :status-filter="statusFilter"
184	      :view-mode="viewMode"
185	      :groups="data.groups"
186	      @update:status-filter="setStatus"
187	      @update:view-mode="setView"
188	      @clear-drill="clearDrill"
189	    />
190	
191	    <div v-if="pending && !data" class="px-7 pb-7 pt-2 text-(--color-ink-muted)">
192	      <div class="h-6 w-40 rounded bg-(--color-border) animate-pulse" />
193	    </div>
194	
195	    <div v-if="error" class="px-7 pb-7 pt-2">
196	      <div class="text-(--color-ink-muted) text-[13px] mb-2">{{ t("mcpPanorama.page.errorLoad") }}</div>
197	      <button
198	        type="button"
199	        class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-(--color-accent) text-(--color-accent-fg) text-[12px] font-medium cursor-pointer"
200	        @click="refresh()"
201	      >
202	        {{ t("mcpPanorama.page.retry") }}
203	      </button>
204	    </div>
205	
206	    <PanoramaView
207	      v-if="data && viewMode === 'panorama'"
208	      :layer="layer"
209	      :stats="!activePrimary && !activeSecondary && statusFilter === 'all'
210	        ? data.layerStats
211	        : computeStats(filteredGroups.flatMap((g) => g.items))"
212	      :groups="filteredGroups"
213	      :active-mcp-id="active?.mcp.id ?? null"
214	      @pick="pickMcp"
215	      @drill="drillTo"
216	      @filter="filterTo"
217	    />

223	      @pick="pickMcp"
224	    />

Checked PR #36 — all CI green (validate, Vercel preview, CodeRabbit), no human reviewers yet. CodeRabbit posted three inline comments:

**1. Sidebar.vue:73 — "Avoid accent on the secondary MCP peer link"** (commented against `a83d16e`)
Already resolved. Commit `ad0e046` on the *next* branch dropped accent from the "By panorama" pill as part of the equal-weight pass. But that commit is in PR #37, not #36 — so from #36's POV the finding is still technically open. Decision belongs upstream.

**2. extensions/index.vue:87 — "Use neutral ink for this secondary navigation link"**
This is the inline `md:hidden` "View the MCP Panorama" anchor (mobile-only, fires when the sidebar is hidden). Still uses `text-(--color-accent)`. Defensible to keep — it's the *sole* mobile entry to a feature that's otherwise hidden — but inconsistent with the equal-weight neutral pills the sidebar now uses on desktop. Worth aligning.

**3. PanoramaSidebarSection.vue:29 — "Initialize expanded domain state on first render"**
**Real bug.** If a user lands on `/mcp-panorama?layer=public&primary=ai&secondary=foo`, `watch(primary, …)` doesn't fire on initial mount, so the active domain row stays collapsed and the active PDT child is invisible. Fix: add `immediate: true` to the watch (one-line change).

My recommendation: fix #3 (real correctness bug) and #2 (visual consistency tweak — accent on a peer entry that's no longer styled as accent anywhere else) on the unified-chrome branch (PR #37) since both files live there now, and treat #1 as already-resolved-downstream when commenting back. Want me to make those two small fixes?

Brief take before the questions:

**Renames** — solid refinement. "By types" was vague; "by task type" (作业类型) and "by target system" (目标系统) say what each axis organizes by — and they're actually accurate (FUNC_TAXONOMY is task/function categories, the panorama groups by sectors/products/systems). Worth aligning English to match the Chinese refinement so the translations stay honest peers.

**`/mcp` URL** — cleaner and more memorable. The asymmetry (only MCP gets its own URL, while Skills/Slash/Plugins live at `/extensions?category=…`) is defensible because MCP is the only category with *two* browsing modes (types + panorama), so it earns the namespace. Old `/extensions?category=mcp` should redirect to `/mcp` for bookmarks. While we're touching URLs, I'd nest the panorama too: `/mcp/panorama` instead of the current hyphenated `/mcp-panorama` — sibling URLs make the "two peer modes" relationship explicit in the URL bar, reinforcing what the sidebar pills already convey.

Two genuine choices to pin down:

## Approved Plan:
# MCP Browse — Dedicated `/mcp` Namespace + Sharper Pill Labels

## Context

Two refinements on PR #36's branch (`refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion`), building on the unified chrome already shipped.

1. **Vague pill labels.** "By types / By panorama" / "按类型 / 按全景图" don't say what each taxonomy actually organizes by. The user reframed them to speak to the underlying axis:
   - Types side: `FUNC_TAXONOMY` is function/task categories → English **"By function"**, Chinese **"按作业类型"**.
   - Panorama side: groups by sectors / domains / products (target systems) → English **"By system"**, Chinese **"按目标系统"**.

2. **MCP browsing buried under `/extensions?category=mcp`.** The current canonical URL for the MCP listing is a query-param view of the unified extensions page. The user wants `/mcp` as a top-level URL — clean, memorable, shareable. While we're touching URLs, the panorama nests as a sibling: `/mcp/panorama` (replacing `/mcp-panorama`). The two URLs become visual siblings in the URL bar, reinforcing the "two peer modes of one experience" relationship the sidebar pills convey.

The asymmetry (MCP gets a top-level namespace, Skills/Slash/Plugins stay under `/extensions?category=…`) is justified: MCP is the *only* category with two browsing modes (types + panorama), so it earns the namespace. The other categories are simple list views, so the query-param treatment continues to fit them.

## Approach

### Commit 1 — Label rename (i18n only)

Update both locales:
- `sidebar.mcp.byTypes`: EN "By types" → **"By function"**, ZH "按类型" → **"按作业类型"**.
- `sidebar.mcp.byPanorama`: EN "By panorama" → **"By system"**, ZH "按全景图" → **"按目标系统"**.

No code changes; both keys are already referenced from `Sidebar.vue`. The `sidebar.mcp.heading` ("Browse MCP" / "浏览 MCP") stays — the heading still names the category accurately.

### Commit 2 — Introduce `/mcp` for the listing

Create the new route and migrate the listing entry points away from the query-param URL.

**New file: `app/pages/mcp/index.vue`** — mirrors `app/pages/extensions/index.vue` but with category locked to `"mcp"`. Concrete behavior:
- `definePageMeta({ layout: "browse" })`.
- Compute `mcpQuery` by merging `route.query` with `category: "mcp"` (overriding any incoming category param).
- Pass `mcpQuery` as the query to `useFetch("/api/internal/extensions", { query: mcpQuery })`.
- Reuse the same `useFilters()` composable, `FilterBar`, `ResultsSummary`, `ExtGridSkeleton`, `ExtGrid` components.
- Search placeholder + empty-state label both pull from `extensions.category.mcp.*` (existing keys).
- `<NuxtLink :to="localePath('/mcp/panorama')" class="md:hidden …">` for the mobile panorama anchor (replaces the prior `md:hidden v-if="isMcpCategory"` block that lived in `extensions/index.vue`).

Some duplication with `extensions/index.vue` is acceptable here — the listing is ~100 lines, mostly template. A shared `<ExtensionListing>` component is a reasonable follow-up but adds scope; out of scope for this PR.

**Update `app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue`** (`Sidebar.vue:12`, `Sidebar.vue:15`):
- Replace `byTypesHref` from `${localePath("/extensions")}?category=mcp` to `localePath("/mcp")`.
- Switch route detection from query-param + name to **route-name-based**:
  ```ts
  const baseName = computed(() => (route.name?.toString() ?? "").split("___")[0])
  const isPanoramaRoute = computed(() => baseName.value === "mcp-panorama")
  const isMcpIndexRoute = computed(() => baseName.value === "mcp")
  const isMcpMode = computed(() => isMcpIndexRoute.value || isPanoramaRoute.value)
  ```
- Existing `byPanoramaHref = localePath("/mcp-panorama")` stays in this commit; commit 3 retargets it.

**Update `app/components/layout/TopBar.vue`** — the MCP nav entry that currently constructs `/extensions?category=mcp` should point at `localePath("/mcp")`. (Need to read the file to know the exact line; the config-style array at `:12` is the entry point.)

**Update `app/pages/extensions/index.vue`** — remove the MCP-specific block:
- The `v-if="isMcpCategory"` mobile panorama anchor (`:80-88`) — gone; lives in `mcp/index.vue` now.
- The `isMcpCategory` computed and the `extensions.category.mcp.*` derivation can stay (they harmlessly do nothing once the redirect fires).
- Add a setup-time guard: if `route.query.category === "mcp"`, `navigateTo(localePath("/mcp"), { replace: true })`. Server-side redirect for old bookmarks.

### Commit 3 — Nest panorama under `/mcp/panorama`

**Move `app/pages/mcp-panorama.vue` → `app/pages/mcp/panorama.vue`** via `git mv`. Nuxt's auto-generated route name stays `mcp-panorama` (nested directory routes flatten with hyphens), so the existing `isPanoramaRoute` detection still works. The URL becomes `/mcp/panorama`.

**Update `app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue`** — `byPanoramaHref` from `localePath("/mcp-panorama")` to `localePath("/mcp/panorama")`.

**Redirect old `/mcp-panorama` URL.** Two options on the table:
- *Nuxt route alias on the new page*: `definePageMeta({ alias: ["/mcp-panorama"] })`. Same content served at both URLs; the URL bar reflects whichever was hit. Cheaper but doesn't canonicalize.
- *Global route middleware*: `app/middleware/legacy-mcp.global.ts` that detects `/mcp-panorama` and `/extensions?category=mcp` and `navigateTo()`s with `{ replace: true }`. Canonicalizes. Heavier.

Recommend the middleware — it consolidates both legacy redirects (Commit 2's `/extensions?category=mcp` and this commit's `/mcp-panorama`) into one file, and gives real 30x semantics. The middleware is locale-aware:
```ts
export default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware((to) => {
  if (to.path.endsWith("/mcp-panorama")) {
    return navigateTo({ path: to.path.replace(/\/mcp-panorama$/, "/mcp/panorama"), query: to.query }, { replace: true })
  }
  if (to.path.endsWith("/extensions") && to.query.category === "mcp") {
    const { category, ...rest } = to.query
    return navigateTo({ path: to.path.replace(/\/extensions$/, "/mcp"), query: rest }, { replace: true })
  }
})
```
(The `extensions/index.vue` setup-time redirect from Commit 2 can be replaced by this middleware — but cleaner to keep the middleware standalone and remove the inline redirect from extensions/index.vue. Will fold that into this commit.)

## Files to modify

1. `i18n/locales/en.json` — `sidebar.mcp.byTypes`, `sidebar.mcp.byPanorama` strings.
2. `i18n/locales/zh.json` — same two keys.
3. **New** `app/pages/mcp/index.vue` — listing locked to category=mcp.
4. **Move** `app/pages/mcp-panorama.vue` → `app/pages/mcp/panorama.vue` (no content changes).
5. **New** `app/middleware/legacy-mcp.global.ts` — global middleware for the two legacy URLs.
6. `app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue` — `byTypesHref`, `byPanoramaHref`, route detection (`baseName` / `isMcpIndexRoute` / `isPanoramaRoute` / `isMcpMode`).
7. `app/components/layout/TopBar.vue` — MCP nav entry's URL.
8. `app/pages/extensions/index.vue` — drop the MCP-specific mobile anchor block and the `isMcpCategory` references in the template; keep the category-aware copy code that already handles the other categories.

## What stays unchanged

- `useFilters()`, `parseFilters`, `serializeFilters`, the `Filters.category` enum value `"mcp"` — the data layer still uses `category=mcp` for filtering and seeding; we're only changing the URL surface.
- `PanoramaSidebarSection.vue`, `usePanoramaState.ts`, the panorama main view components — none of them reference the URL directly; they read state via `usePanoramaState` from `route.query`, which works under any path.
- `/extensions` (the unfiltered all-extensions listing) and `/extensions?category=skills|slash|plugins` URLs — unchanged. Only `category=mcp` redirects out.
- The browse layout, `Sidebar`'s top half (Browse MCP block + pills), the conditional bottom section. All still work; only the link targets and detection logic update.

## Verification

After all three commits, run `bun run dev` and walk through:

1. **`/en/mcp`** — renders the MCP listing with the same filter rail + sort + grid as before. Sidebar shows Browse MCP pills (`By function` active, neutral, non-clickable; `By system` is a NuxtLink to `/en/mcp/panorama`). Bottom of sidebar = FUNC_TAXONOMY Categories.
2. **`/en/extensions?category=mcp`** — server redirects (replace: true) to `/en/mcp`. URL bar canonicalizes.
3. **`/en/mcp/panorama`** — panorama page renders under the same browse layout. Sidebar pills swap (panorama active). Bottom of sidebar = panorama controls (layer toggle + drill tree). All existing URL-driven state (`?layer=industry&primary=…`) still drives SSR.
4. **`/en/mcp-panorama`** — server redirects (replace: true) to `/en/mcp/panorama`. URL bar canonicalizes.
5. **`/en/extensions?category=skills`** (and slash, plugins) — unchanged. No Browse MCP block; existing FUNC_TAXONOMY sidebar.
6. **Click "By function"** from `/en/mcp/panorama` — navigates to `/en/mcp`. **Click "By system"** from `/en/mcp` — navigates to `/en/mcp/panorama`. No layout shift.
7. **Mobile** (`<md`) on `/en/mcp` — sidebar hidden; the `md:hidden` panorama anchor renders above the search form, links to `/en/mcp/panorama`.
8. **TopBar** "MCP Servers" nav link — points at `/en/mcp` (not the old query URL).
9. **Bilingual** — `/zh/mcp` and `/zh/mcp/panorama` render Chinese labels: `按作业类型` / `按目标系统`.
10. **Tests + checks** — `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run test` all green.

1	# MCP Browse — Dedicated `/mcp` Namespace + Sharper Pill Labels
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Two refinements on PR #36's branch (`refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion`), building on the unified chrome already shipped.
6	
7	1. **Vague pill labels.** "By types / By panorama" / "按类型 / 按全景图" don't say what each taxonomy actually organizes by. The user reframed them to speak to the underlying axis:
8	   - Types side: `FUNC_TAXONOMY` is function/task categories → English **"By function"**, Chinese **"按作业类型"**.
9	   - Panorama side: groups by sectors / domains / products (target systems) → English **"By system"**, Chinese **"按目标系统"**.
10	
11	2. **MCP browsing buried under `/extensions?category=mcp`.** The current canonical URL for the MCP listing is a query-param view of the unified extensions page. The user wants `/mcp` as a top-level URL — clean, memorable, shareable. While we're touching URLs, the panorama nests as a sibling: `/mcp/panorama` (replacing `/mcp-panorama`). The two URLs become visual siblings in the URL bar, reinforcing the "two peer modes of one experience" relationship the sidebar pills convey.
12	
13	The asymmetry (MCP gets a top-level namespace, Skills/Slash/Plugins stay under `/extensions?category=…`) is justified: MCP is the *only* category with two browsing modes (types + panorama), so it earns the namespace. The other categories are simple list views, so the query-param treatment continues to fit them.
14	
15	## Approach
16	
17	### Commit 1 — Label rename (i18n only)
18	
19	Update both locales:
20	- `sidebar.mcp.byTypes`: EN "By types" → **"By function"**, ZH "按类型" → **"按作业类型"**.

> AGENT

Brief take before the question: yes, makes the URLs symmetric (`/skills`, `/mcp`, `/slash`, `/plugins`) and lets the TopBar links go to clean top-level routes. But it shifts the cost-benefit on a refactor I deferred earlier — with 4 nearly-identical pages, an `<ExtensionListing :category="…">` extraction stops being optional. So this PR really has two parts: extract the listing into a shared component, then mount it under each of the four routes (plus the existing `/extensions` for the "all" view), plus extend the redirect middleware to cover the three new legacy URLs.

One thing worth pinning down before I write the plan — the slash-commands URL.

All other URLs match their enum names: `/skills`, `/mcp`, `/plugins`.\n\n`/extensions` keeps existing as the unfiltered \"all extensions\" view, reachable via direct URL — no nav points to it, but it's the natural fallback and the sidebar's taxonomy can route to it.\n\n## Approach\n\n### Commit 1 — Extract `<ExtensionListing>` and rewire `mcp/index.vue` + `extensions/index.vue`\n\n**New file: `app/components/extension/ExtensionListing.vue`** (~100 lines) — takes a single prop `category: \"all\" | \"skills\" | \"mcp\" | \"slash\" | \"plugins\"` and contains everything the current `mcp/index.vue` does:\n\n- Builds `fetchQuery` from `route.query`; when `category !== \"all\"`, force-merges `category: props.category` into the query (so URL query like `?scope=…&tags=…` survive, but `category` is locked to the page's identity).\n- Calls `useFetch(\"/api/internal/extensions\", { query: fetchQuery, ... })`.\n- Same `useFetch(\"/api/internal/facets\", ...)` for facets.\n- Same debounced search input, `useFilters()`, `filtersActive`, etc.\n- Search placeholder → `t(\\`extensions.category.${category}.searchPlaceholder\\`)`.\n- Category label for ExtGrid empty states → `t(\\`extensions.category.${category}.label\\`)`.\n- Mobile panorama anchor (`md:hidden`, links to `/mcp/panorama`) — render only when `category === \"mcp\"`.\n- `clearFiltersHref` derives from the canonical URL for the category:\n  ```ts\n  const canonicalPath = computed(() => {\n    if (props.category === \"all\") return localePath(\"/extensions\")\n    if (props.category === \"slash\") return localePath(\"/commands\")\n    return localePath(`/${props.category}`)\n  })\n  ```\n\n**Refactor `app/pages/mcp/index.vue`** down to a thin wrapper:\n```vue\n<script setup lang=\"ts\">\ndefinePageMeta({ layout: \"browse\" })\n</script>\n<template>\n  <ExtensionListing category=\"mcp\" />\n</template>\n```\n\n**Refactor `app/pages/extensions/index.vue`** to render `<ExtensionListing category=\"all\" />` only. URL is `/commands`, prop is `\"slash\"` — the slug-URL divergence)\n- `app/pages/plugins.vue` → `<ExtensionListing category=\"plugins\" />`\n\nEach is ~5 lines: `<script setup>` with `definePageMeta({ \"/plugins\",\n}\n\nexport default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware((to) => {\n  if (to.path.endsWith(\"/mcp-panorama\")) {\n    return navigateTo(\n      { path: to.path.replace(/\\/mcp-panorama$/, CATEGORY_REDIRECTS[to.query.category]\n    if (dest) {\n      const { category: _category, ...rest } = to.query\n      return navigateTo(\n        { path: to.path.replace(/\\/extensions$/, dest), clicks should stay on the current category page, not redirect to `/extensions`. Currently:\n```ts\nconst path = localePath(\"/extensions\")\n```\nChange to base on the current route:\n```ts\nconst path = (() => {\n  switch (baseName.value) {\n    case \"skills\": return localePath(\"/skills\")\n    case \"mcp\":    return localePath(\"/mcp\")\n    case \"commands\": return localePath(\"/commands\")\n    case \"plugins\": return localePath(\"/plugins\")\n    default: return localePath(\"/extensions\")\n  }\n})()\n```\nThat way clicking `Engineering` from `/skills` lands on `/skills?funcCat=engineering` — narrows within skills instead of broadening to all extensions.\n\nThe existing route detection (`baseName`, `isPanoramaRoute`, `isMcpIndexRoute`, `isMcpMode`) is unaffected; ## Approved Plan:
# Promote All Category Listings to Top-Level URLs

## Phase 0 — Fix the failing CI on PR #36 (commitlint)

The latest `validate` workflow on PR #36 failed because commit `8e1be26` was authored as `i18n(sidebar): rename Browse MCP pills…` and commitlint only accepts these types: `feat | fix | refactor | test | docs | chore | perf | revert | style | build | ci`. `i18n` should have been the *scope*, not the *type*.

Three later commits (`4c36144`, `80903eb`) sit on top of `8e1be26`, so the fix is a history rewrite. CLAUDE.md normally bars force-pushes, so this needs explicit authorization (which is what approving this plan grants).

**Approach.** Non-interactive rebase that rewrites only the message of `8e1be26`:

```bash
git switch --detach 8e1be26
git commit --amend -m "refactor(i18n): rename Browse MCP pills to By function / By system" \
                  -m "<original body, preserved verbatim>"
git rebase --onto HEAD 8e1be26 refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion
git push --force-with-lease origin refactor/extensions-listing-cohesion
```

- `refactor` is the right type — renaming user-facing labels is a behavior-preserving refactor of presentation.
- `(i18n)` stays as the scope so the categorization is still readable in `git log`.
- `--force-with-lease` (not `--force`) protects against silently overwriting if someone else pushed in the meantime.
- No `-i` flag used (per CLAUDE.md), no `--no-verify`, no GPG bypass.

Subsequent commits get new SHAs but the same trees and messages. PR #36 re-runs CI on the new tip and the commitlint job should pass.

After Phase 0 succeeds, continue with the category-URL work below.

## Context

The prior pass shipped `/mcp` and `/mcp/panorama` as a top-level namespace for MCP browsing. The user now wants the other primary categories to follow the same pattern: `/skills`, `/commands` (for slash commands — user chose this over `/slash`), `/plugins`. The current `/extensions?category=…` URLs become legacy redirects.

Two reasons this is worth doing:

1. **Symmetry.** Today the URL surface is asymmetric — MCP lives at a top-level route while Skills/Slash/Plugins live at query-param URLs. Promoting all four makes the pattern uniform and the URLs memorable/shareable.
2. **Forces the right refactor.** The previous PR left `mcp/index.vue` as a near-duplicate of `extensions/index.vue` with category locked to `"mcp"` — about 100 lines of overlap. Adding three more category pages would quadruple that duplication. The extraction I deferred earlier (`<ExtensionListing :category="…">`) becomes mandatory now and pays off immediately.

URL decision (user-picked): slash commands live at **`/commands`** (the category enum value stays `"slash"` — only the URL surface diverges). All other URLs match their enum names: `/skills`, `/mcp`, `/plugins`.

`/extensions` keeps existing as the unfiltered "all extensions" view, reachable via direct URL — no nav points to it, but it's the natural fallback and the sidebar's taxonomy can route to it.

## Approach

### Commit 1 — Extract `<ExtensionListing>` and rewire `mcp/index.vue` + `extensions/index.vue`

**New file: `app/components/extension/ExtensionListing.vue`** (~100 lines) — takes a single prop `category: "all" | "skills" | "mcp" | "slash" | "plugins"` and contains everything the current `mcp/index.vue` does:

- Builds `fetchQuery` from `route.query`; when `category !== "all"`, force-merges `category: props.category` into the query (so URL query like `?scope=…&tags=…` survive, but `category` is locked to the page's identity).
- Calls `useFetch("/api/internal/extensions", { query: fetchQuery, ... })`.
- Same `useFetch("/api/internal/facets", ...)` for facets.
- Same debounced search input, `useFilters()`, `filtersActive`, etc.
- Search placeholder → `t(\`extensions.category.${category}.searchPlaceholder\`)`.
- Category label for ExtGrid empty states → `t(\`extensions.category.${category}.label\`)`.
- Mobile panorama anchor (`md:hidden`, links to `/mcp/panorama`) — render only when `category === "mcp"`.
- `clearFiltersHref` derives from the canonical URL for the category:
  ```ts
  const canonicalPath = computed(() => {
    if (props.category === "all") return localePath("/extensions")
    if (props.category === "slash") return localePath("/commands")
    return localePath(`/${props.category}`)
  })
  ```

**Refactor `app/pages/mcp/index.vue`** down to a thin wrapper:
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
definePageMeta({ layout: "browse" })
</script>
<template>
  <ExtensionListing category="mcp" />
</template>
```

**Refactor `app/pages/extensions/index.vue`** to render `<ExtensionListing category="all" />` only. Drop the local `categoryKey`/`searchPlaceholder`/`categoryLabel` derivations, the debounced search input, etc. — all moved into the shared component. The redirect-when-category=mcp logic is already gone (handled by middleware in the prior commit) so this page becomes the same trivial shell.

### Commit 2 — Add `/skills`, `/commands`, `/plugins` pages + update TopBar

**New page files:**

- `app/pages/skills.vue` → `<ExtensionListing category="skills" />`
- `app/pages/commands.vue` → `<ExtensionListing category="slash" />`  (note: URL is `/commands`, prop is `"slash"` — the slug-URL divergence)
- `app/pages/plugins.vue` → `<ExtensionListing category="plugins" />`

Each is ~5 lines: `<script setup>` with `definePageMeta({ layout: "browse" })` and a `<template>` mounting `<ExtensionListing>`.

**Update `app/components/layout/TopBar.vue`** (`hrefFor` at the top of `<script setup>`):
```ts
function hrefFor(key: CategoryKey): RouteLocationRaw {
  if (key === "mcp") return localePath("/mcp")
  if (key === "skills") return localePath("/skills")
  if (key === "slash") return localePath("/commands")
  if (key === "plugins") return localePath("/plugins")
  return { path: localeExtensionsPath.value, query: { category: key } }
}
```

And `isCategoryActive`:
```ts
function isCategoryActive(key: CategoryKey): boolean {
  if (key === "mcp") return baseName.value === "mcp" || baseName.value === "mcp-panorama"
  if (key === "skills") return baseName.value === "skills"
  if (key === "slash") return baseName.value === "commands"
  if (key === "plugins") return baseName.value === "plugins"
  if (route.path !== localeExtensionsPath.value) return false
  return route.query.category === key
}
```

The mobile "Browse" link at `:42` (which currently points at `category=skills`) updates to `localePath("/skills")`.

### Commit 3 — Extend the redirect middleware + Sidebar taxonomy fix

**Rename** `app/middleware/legacy-mcp.global.ts` → `app/middleware/legacy-categories.global.ts` to reflect the broader scope.

**Extend the redirects:**
```ts
const CATEGORY_REDIRECTS: Record<string, string> = {
  skills: "/skills",
  mcp: "/mcp",
  slash: "/commands",
  plugins: "/plugins",
}

export default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware((to) => {
  if (to.path.endsWith("/mcp-panorama")) {
    return navigateTo(
      { path: to.path.replace(/\/mcp-panorama$/, "/mcp/panorama"), query: to.query },
      { replace: true },
    )
  }

  if (to.path.endsWith("/extensions") && typeof to.query.category === "string") {
    const dest = CATEGORY_REDIRECTS[to.query.category]
    if (dest) {
      const { category: _category, ...rest } = to.query
      return navigateTo(
        { path: to.path.replace(/\/extensions$/, dest), query: rest },
        { replace: true },
      )
    }
  }
})
```

**Update `app/components/layout/Sidebar.vue`'s `buildHref`** — when on one of the new category routes, the FUNC_TAXONOMY clicks should stay on the current category page, not redirect to `/extensions`. Currently:
```ts
const path = localePath("/extensions")
```
Change to base on the current route:
```ts
const path = (() => {
  switch (baseName.value) {
    case "skills": return localePath("/skills")
    case "mcp":    return localePath("/mcp")
    case "commands": return localePath("/commands")
    case "plugins": return localePath("/plugins")
    default: return localePath("/extensions")
  }
})()
```
That way clicking `Engineering` from `/skills` lands on `/skills?funcCat=engineering` — narrows within skills instead of broadening to all extensions.

The existing route detection (`baseName`, `isPanoramaRoute`, `isMcpIndexRoute`, `isMcpMode`) is unaffected; FUNC_TAXONOMY only renders when the user is *not* on the panorama route, which covers all four new category pages.

- Rebased `8e1be26` → `7d6aac6` to retype it `refactor(i18n)` (was `i18n(sidebar)`, which commitlint rejected).
- Validate is now green on the new tip.

**Phase 1 — Promote all category listings**
- `3fb0873` — extracted `<ExtensionListing :category="…">`; `mcp/index.vue` and `extensions/index.vue` shrink to 4-line wrappers.
- `52da8d5` — added `/skills`, `/commands`, `/plugins` pages; TopBar's `hrefFor` / `isCategoryActive` learn the new routes (slash URL diverges to `/commands` while the enum stays `slash`).
- `6d6455a` — middleware renamed to `legacy-categories.global.ts` and now covers all four `category=…` redirects plus `/mcp-panorama` → `/mcp/panorama`. Sidebar's `buildHref` derives the base path from the current route so FUNC_TAXONOMY clicks stay inside the active category.

**Verified live:**

# Architecture

How AgentCenter (Nuxt) fits together today. For *what we plan to build next*, see [`plan.md`](./plan.md). For deployment, see [`deploy.md`](./deploy.md). For the public CLI contract, see [`api.md`](./api.md).

## Topology

```text
Browser ───▶ Nuxt 4 (Nitro on Node) ───▶ PostgreSQL
                ├── pages (Vue SSR + island hydration)
                ├── /api/auth/...           Better Auth handler
                ├── /api/v1/...             Public registry API (CLI surface)
                ├── /api/internal/...       Form-backing endpoints (web surface)
                ├── /api/upload/sign        Presigned upload URL
                └── /api/inngest            Inngest webhook
                                                  │
Browser ───── direct PUT ─────▶ Supabase / R2 ◀───┘
                                                  │
                                              Inngest ──▶ Postgres + Storage
                                                          (scan-bundle,
                                                           reindex-search)

CLI (Bun binary) ──── /api/v1/... ────▶ Nuxt
        Bearer token via device-code flow on the same `sessions` table
```

The web app and the CLI hit the same Nuxt deployment. Bundles flow directly between the browser/CLI and object storage via signed URLs — Nuxt never proxies binary content.

## Directory layout

```text
app/                              # Vue + composables (browser + SSR render)
├── app.vue                       # entry — useTheme(), useHead, NuxtLayout/Page
├── error.vue                     # global error boundary
├── layouts/default.vue           # skip link + TopBar + Sidebar + main slot
├── pages/                        # @nuxtjs/i18n auto-prefixes /en, /zh
│   ├── index.vue                 # home (featured + trending grid)
│   ├── extensions/
│   │   ├── index.vue             # browse
│   │   └── [slug].vue            # detail
│   ├── sign-in.vue / sign-up.vue / onboard.vue
│   ├── cli/auth.vue              # device-code authorization
│   └── publish/{index,new}.vue
├── components/
│   ├── layout/                   # TopBar, Sidebar, ThemeSwitch, LocaleSwitch, UserButton
│   ├── extension/                # ExtCard, ExtGrid, InstallButton, Markdown
│   └── filters/                  # FilterBar, ScopePills, FilterChips, SortSelect
├── composables/                  # useTheme, useFilters, useAuth
├── middleware/                   # require-auth, require-onboard
└── assets/css/tailwind.css       # @theme tokens + .dark variant
server/                           # Nitro request handlers + server utilities
├── api/
│   ├── v1/                       # FROZEN CONTRACT — see docs/api.md
│   ├── internal/                 # form-backing endpoints called via $fetch
│   ├── auth/[...all].ts          # Better Auth catch-all
│   ├── upload/sign.post.ts
│   └── inngest.ts                # webhook → inngest/node serve()
└── utils/                        # SERVER-ONLY HELPERS
    ├── db.ts                     # postgres-js + drizzle singleton
    ├── auth.ts                   # useAuthServer, getSessionUser, requireUser
    ├── api-auth.ts               # authenticateBearerToken (CLI)
...
--- features.md tail ---
- **我的工作台** ——每位登录用户的个人主页。展示昵称、部门、加入月份，以及四项核心数据：已安装数、已发布数、你发布的扩展总安装量、加权平均评分。
- **可编辑的资料** ——修改昵称、部门和一段简介；邮箱和加入时间为只读。
- **已安装列表** ——你安装过的所有扩展，附当前运行版本。
- **我发布的扩展** ——你发布过的扩展，每行带版本、安装量、评分。
- **草稿列表** ——发布流程中的草稿，带"继续"按钮；仅在"等待扫描"或"已被拒"时显示状态。
- **收藏列表** ——你收藏的扩展，按最近收藏排序。
- **动态时间线** ——你的安装、发布、评分合并为一条时间线（最近 20 条）。

### 语言与主题

- **双语界面** ——英文（默认）+ 中文，URL 始终带语言前缀（`/en`、`/zh`）。
- **双语内容** ——扩展标题、描述、标签、组织名、部门名均支持双语字段。
- **主题** —— Editorial Ivory（默认）、Dark 与 Mono Clean（高对比极简）；按账号保存偏好。

### 多租户（v1 仅 Schema）

- **组织与部门** ——数据库已建模并播种；v1 UI 为单租户。
- **部门层级** ——点路径标识；支持后代筛选。
- **Memberships** ——用户可属于多个组织。

### 公共 API

- **注册表 API（`/api/v1/...`）** ——与 Web UI 列表语义一致；供 CLI 调用。

### CLI

- **与 Agent 无关** ——面向多 Agent 设计，默认面向 Claude。
- **分发** ——以 Node JS bundle 形式分发，可跨平台 npm 安装。
- **数据来源** ——调用公共注册表 API；安装无需登录。
- **当前支持 Skill 安装** —— MCP / 斜杠命令 / 插件的安装器在路线图上。

Honest read: yes — three gaps are worth filling, ranked by how load-bearing they are.

**1. `docs/architecture.md` is stale** (high value). The directory-layout section lists `pages/extensions/index.vue` but not the new `pages/mcp/{index,panorama}.vue`, `pages/skills.vue`, `pages/commands.vue`, `pages/plugins.vue`. The `middleware/` line lists `require-auth, require-onboard` but not `legacy-categories.global.ts`. The `components/extension/` line doesn't mention `ExtensionListing.vue`, `ResultsSummary.vue`, or the new `PanoramaSidebarSection.vue`. New contributors lean on this map.

**2. Middleware redirect test** (medium-high value). The redirect map in `app/middleware/legacy-categories.global.ts` is a contract — if someone adds a 5th category, they need to update three places (the map, Sidebar's `buildHref`, TopBar's `hrefFor`). A small test asserting each legacy URL canonicalizes to the right new URL would catch divergence. Right now nothing protects it.

**3. Sidebar test coverage for the new modes** (medium value). `Sidebar.nuxt.test.ts` exercises the default route (no MCP mode, no panorama mode). The Browse MCP pills and the conditional `PanoramaSidebarSection` are now major behaviors with no test coverage. New cases for "on `/mcp` shows Browse MCP block with By function active" and "on `/mcp/panorama` shows PanoramaSidebarSection" would protect both the route-detection logic and the pill cross-linking.

Things I'd skip: ExtensionListing render test (overlaps with existing `useFilters` tests, fragile), thin-wrapper page tests, `usePanoramaState` composable test (it's small and tightly coupled to PanoramaSidebarSection which would be the better integration surface, but lower priority than the three above).

For docs beyond architecture.md: `features.md` could mention the new URLs and the `slash → /commands` divergence, but it's user-facing copy not architectural — fine to skip on this PR. A note in `daily-log.md` is what the `/update-features-and-daily-log` skill is for; you can run it yourself end-of-day.

Want me to do all three (architecture doc + middleware test + sidebar test cases) on this branch, or just the first two?

85	### Layer boundaries (ESLint-enforced)
86	
87	```text
88	shared/   ──▶  (leaf — no framework imports, no app/server/ either)
89	server/   ──▶  shared/
90	app/      ──▶  shared/  (no direct server/ — talks to it over $fetch)
91	cli/      ──▶  (its own world; only sees /api/v1)
92	```
93	
94	`no-restricted-imports` rules in `eslint.config.mjs` enforce this. Violations fail CI.
95	
96	## Request flows
97	
98	### Browse (anonymous read)
99	
100	```text
101	GET /en/extensions?category=skills&sort=stars
102	  └─ app/pages/extensions/index.vue (SSR'd by Nitro)
103	      ├─ useFilters() reads route.query → parseFilters() typed Filters
104	      └─ useFetch("/api/internal/extensions", { query: route.query })
105	                                       │
106	            ┌──────────────────────────┘
107	            ▼
108	      server/api/internal/extensions.get.ts
109	          ├─ parseFilters(searchParams) again (server side, defensive)
110	          ├─ try/catch around Promise.all([
111	          │     listExtensions(filters),
112	          │     countFilteredExtensions(filters),
113	          │   ])  → 500 on db error
114	          └─ returns { items, total, filters }
115	```
116	
117	`buildExtensionWhere(db, filters)` in `shared/search/query.ts` is pure; takes the db client as a parameter so it stays inside the `shared/` boundary. Same function powers `/api/v1/extensions` so the CLI sees the same filter semantics as the web.
118	
119	### Detail
120	
121	```text
122	GET /en/extensions/<slug>
123	  └─ app/pages/extensions/[slug].vue (SSR)
124	      └─ useFetch("/api/internal/extension-detail", { query: { slug } })
125	                                       │
126	            ┌──────────────────────────┘
127	            ▼
128	      server/api/internal/extension-detail.get.ts
129	          ├─ getExtensionBySlug(slug)        ← server/utils/queries/extension-detail.ts
130	          ├─ Promise.all:
131	          │     listExtensionVersions(id)
132	          │     getRelatedExtensions(id, cat)
133	          └─ returns { ext, versions, related }
134	```
135	
136	The page renders a two-column layout (hero + README via `<Markdown>` on the left, metadata sidebar + Related list on the right). `<Markdown>` runs `markdown-it` → `DOMPurify` with an explicit tag/attr allowlist and a tight `ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP` that blocks `javascript:`, `data:`, `file:`, `vbscript:`. Homepage and repo URLs pass through a separate `safeExternalUrl()` allowlist.
137	
138	### Auth (web)
139	
140	Better Auth instance lives at `server/utils/auth.ts` as a lazy singleton (`useAuthServer`). The Drizzle adapter is wired against the existing `users` / `sessions` / `accounts` / `verifications` tables. Three additional fields (`locale`, `themePreference`, `defaultDeptId`) are declared via `additionalFields` with `input: false` — set by app code, not the auth form.
141	
142	```text
143	Browser ── POST /api/auth/sign-up/email ──▶ Nuxt
144	              ├─ server/api/auth/[...all].ts → toWebRequest(event) → auth.handler()
145	              ├─ Better Auth: hash, insert users row, mint session, Set-Cookie
146	              └─ 200 { user, session }
147	
148	(then) require-onboard middleware:
149	  ├─ SSR branch:  auth.getSession({ headers: toFetchHeaders(useRequestHeaders(["cookie"])) })
150	  └─ Client:      auth.useSession() reactive ref
151	  if user.defaultDeptId is null → navigateTo(localePath("/onboard"))
152	```
153	
154	`require-auth` middleware redirects unauthenticated requests to `/sign-in?next=<originalPath>`. Both middleware are named, not global — pages opt in via `definePageMeta({ middleware: ["require-auth", "require-onboard"] })`.
155	
156	### Auth (CLI device-code)
157	
158	Two parallel flows back the same `sessions` table:
159	
160	```text
161	CLI                                             Nuxt                                User browser
162	──── POST /api/v1/auth/device/code ──▶ creates two verifications rows
163	                                       (dc:poll:<deviceCode>,
164	                                        dc:user:<userCode>) in one tx
165	   ◀─ { deviceCode, userCode,
166	        verificationUri: "/cli/auth" }
167	                                                                          ▶ opens /en/cli/auth
168	                                                                            (require-auth)
169	                                                                            types user code
170	                                                                            submits → POST
171	                                                                            /api/internal/
172	                                                                            device-authorize
173	                                                                            (requireUser)
174	                                                                            ├─ resolve userCode
175	                                                                            │   → deviceCode
176	                                                                            ├─ insert 30-day
177	                                                                            │   sessions row
178	                                                                            │   (CLI token)
179	                                                                            ├─ stamp poll row
180	                                                                            │   authorized=true
181	                                                                            └─ delete lookup row
182	─── POST /api/v1/auth/device/poll ───▶ reads poll row by deviceCode
183	   ◀─ { status: "authorized", token } ◀── deletes poll row, returns token once
184	   (CLI stores token in
185	    ~/.config/agentcenter/credentials.json mode 0600)
186	```
187	
188	Subsequent `/api/v1/*` writes from the CLI carry the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. `authenticateBearerToken(event)` in `server/utils/api-auth.ts` joins `sessions` to `users` to resolve the caller.
189	
190	### Publish
191	
192	```text
193	Browser                          Nitro                          Storage     Inngest
194	   │ /publish/new ──submit────▶│
195	   ├ POST /api/internal/publish/create-draft (ManifestFormSchema)
196	   │       │                    │
197	   │       │   transactional:
198	   │       │     insert extensions (visibility=draft, funcCat/subCat backfilled)
199	   │       │     insert extension_versions (status=pending)
200	   │       │     insert extension_tags
201	   │       │
202	   │   ◀── { extensionId, versionId }
203	   │
204	   ├ POST /api/upload/sign (slug + version) (requireUser-gated)
205	   │   ◀── { url, key = bundles/<slug>/<version>/bundle.zip }
206	   │
207	   ├ PUT  <signed url> ─────────────────────▶ direct browser → storage
208	   │
209	   ├ POST /api/internal/publish/attach-file
210	   │       │  (requireUser-gated, ownership-checked: version→extension→publisherUserId)
211	   │       │  transactional: insert files + UPDATE version.bundleFileId
212	   │       │  (UPDATE uses .returning() and throws on 0 rows to force rollback)
213	   │
214	   ├ POST /api/internal/publish/submit
215	   │       │  (ownership-checked again)
216	   │       │  state.submit() — pending|scanning → scanning (idempotent retry)
217	   │       │  inngest.send("extension/scan.requested", { versionId, fileId })
218	   │       │  rollback scanning→pending if inngest.send fails
219	   │       │
220	                                          inngest receives event,
221	                                          calls /api/inngest webhook
222	                                                                          │
223	                                              ┌───────────────────────────┘
224	                                              ▼
225	                                     scan-bundle:
226	                                       fetch signed download URL
227	                                       SHA-256 the bytes
228	                                       fflate unzipSync   (try/catch → invalid_zip)
229	                                       smol-toml parse manifest.toml
230	                                       BundleManifestSchema.safeParse
231	                                       recordScanResult(versionId, fileId, ok | reject)
232	                                         ├─ scope = personal:
233	                                         │     files.scanStatus=clean
234	                                         │     version.status=ready + publishedAt
235	                                         │     extensions.visibility=published + publishedAt
236	                                         │     (one transaction)
237	                                         └─ scope = org|enterprise:
238	                                              files.scanStatus=clean
239	                                              version.status=ready
240	                                              (admin must publishVersion later)
241	                                       on failure:
242	                                         files.scanStatus=flagged
243	                                         version.status=rejected
244	                                       sendEvent("extension/index.requested")
245	                                              │
246	                                              ▼
247	                                     reindex-search:
248	                                       publishVersion(versionId)
249	                                       sendEvent("extension/published")
250	```
251	
252	Two design decisions worth knowing:
253	
254	- **`recordScanResult` branches on extension scope**: `personal` is the auto-publish path; `org` / `enterprise` wait for an admin curation call to `publishVersion`. The scan job doesn't have to know the rule — `recordScanResult` joins `extensions` and reads `scope`.
255	- **`extensions.search_vector` is a Postgres `GENERATED ALWAYS … STORED` column** — no application code writes to it. The reindex job exists for the publish flip + the downstream `extension/published` event, not for any DB write to the search vector.
256	
257	### Install (web)
258	
259	```text
260	Browser ── click InstallButton ──▶ POST /api/internal/installs (requireUser)
261	                                       │
262	                                       ▼
263	                          recordInstall in server/utils/installs.ts:
264	                            tx.select prior installs for (user, ext)  → isFirstInstall
265	                            tx.insert installs row
266	                            tx.upsert into the "Installed" collection
267	                            tx.update extensions set downloadsCount = downloadsCount + 1
268	                          (all four writes in one transaction)
269	                          getOrCreateSystemCollection seeds the Installed
270	                          collection lazily on first read — decoupled from
271	                          Better Auth signUp hook (per the locked plan).
272	```
273	
274	### Install (CLI)
275	
276	```text
277	agentcenter install <slug>
278	  ├── GET /api/v1/extensions/<slug>           metadata + bundleUrl
279	  ├── GET /api/v1/extensions/<slug>/bundle    302 → signed storage URL
280	  ├── fetch(signedUrl) → ZIP bytes
281	  ├── unzip + write to manifest.install.<agent> dir (~/.claude/skills/<slug>)
282	  └── POST /api/v1/installs (Bearer)           records the event
283	```
284	
285	The bundle endpoint resolves the latest **`status="ready"`** version by `publishedAt DESC NULLS LAST, createdAt DESC`. Returns 503 + `bundle_unavailable` if no ready version exists yet (still scanning, scan failed, etc.). The signed URL is short-lived (default ~5 minutes from `storage.getSignedDownloadUrl`); clients should fetch immediately.
286	
287	## Storage backend
288	
289	`server/utils/storage.ts` exports a single `useStorage()` lazy-singleton. The backend is picked from env at first call:
290	
291	- `R2_ACCOUNT_ID` set → Cloudflare R2 (via `@aws-sdk/client-s3` + `@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner`)
292	- otherwise `SUPABASE_URL` set → Supabase Storage (via `@supabase/supabase-js` `createSignedUploadUrl` / `createSignedUrl`)
293	- both unset → throws a clear "storage not configured" error on first use, not at module load
294	
295	Both backends implement the same `StorageBackend` interface (`bundleKey`, `getSignedUploadUrl`, `getSignedDownloadUrl`). Swapping is a config flip, not a code change. Both SDKs ship in the bundle; only the configured one runs at request time.
296	
297	`bundleKey(slug, version)` returns `bundles/<slug>/<version>/bundle.zip`. Slug + version are locked once a draft is persisted (the wizard refuses to write them via `updateDraftExtension`) — they form the object key, and letting them shift would orphan the upload.
298	
299	## Auth model summary
300	
301	```text
302	Web sessions:   cookie ◀─▶ sessions.token  (Better Auth handler at /api/auth)
303	CLI sessions:   Bearer  ◀─▶ sessions.token  (device-code flow → 30-day token)
304	                                            (Bearer recognized by api-auth.ts,
305	                                             which joins sessions to users)
306	```
307	
308	Same table, two transport mechanisms. The CLI's `verifications`-based device-code flow lives alongside Better Auth's own usage of the `verifications` table for email-verification — they use distinct `identifier` namespaces (`dc:poll:*`, `dc:user:*` vs the Better Auth defaults).
309	
310	## i18n
311	
312	- `@nuxtjs/i18n` with `strategy: "prefix"`. Locales `en` (default) + `zh`. Always-prefixed URLs (`/en/...`, `/zh/...`); the i18n module owns the locale segment — **pages live at `app/pages/...`, NOT `app/pages/[locale]/...`**.
313	- Static UI strings in `i18n/locales/{en,zh}.json`. Keys are namespaced by feature (`Sidebar.browse`, `nav.toggleSidebar`, `publish.fields.summary`).
314	- Dynamic content (extension names, descriptions, dept names, tag labels): **column-per-language** in Postgres (`name` + `nameZh`, `description` + `descriptionZh`, `tags.labelEn` + `tags.labelZh`). Component-level locale switching reads the appropriate column.
315	- Locale switcher swaps the segment via `useSwitchLocalePath()`, preserving query string.
316	
317	## Theme
318	
319	Editorial Ivory (default) + Dark. Cookie name: `theme`, values `ivory | dark`. The no-flash-on-hydrate trick:
320	
321	```ts
322	// app/composables/useTheme.ts
323	const cookie = useCookie<Theme>("theme", { default: () => "ivory", ... })
324	useHead({ htmlAttrs: { class: computed(() => cookie.value === "dark" ? "dark" : "") } })
325	```
326	
327	Called synchronously in `app.vue`'s `<script setup>` so unhead serializes the class into the SSR HTML before the response stream. Client toggling is reactive — no `router.refresh()`. Tailwind v4's `@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *))` in `tailwind.css` activates `dark:` utilities against the same class.
328	
329	## Error handling
330	
331	- **Page-level**: `app/error.vue` catches any throw that escapes a page. Wrapped in `<NuxtLayout>` so the topbar/sidebar render and users can navigate away. Dev console logs the full error; production logs only `{ statusCode, message }` (avoids leaking Drizzle SQL fragments).
332	- **Endpoint-level**: all `/api/v1/*` endpoints return the documented `{ error, message }` shape via `apiError(event, message, status, code)` which throws an `H3Error` typed `never`. Internal endpoints throw `createError({ statusCode, statusMessage })` directly; the global error page handles them.
333	- **Inngest jobs**: catch `VersionStateError` from state-machine writes — these mean a duplicate Inngest delivery, treated as idempotent no-op (with a `console.warn` for triage).
334	
335	## Background jobs
336	
337	- Inngest client is a lazy module-level singleton in `server/utils/inngest.ts`. Function list is itself lazy-loaded via dynamic `import()` so unrelated server modules don't pull `fflate` / `smol-toml` into their import graph.
338	- Webhook endpoint at `server/api/inngest.ts` calls `serve()` from `inngest/node` and awaits it — without the await, the Nuxt response could close before Inngest finishes signature verification + step dispatch.
339	- `INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY` is read by `serve()` from env automatically.
340	- For local dev, run `bunx inngest-cli@1.19.2 dev` — auto-discovers `/api/inngest` and routes events locally. No keys needed in dev (the client uses `isDev: true` when `NODE_ENV !== "production"`).
341	
342	## Validate pipeline
343	
344	`bun run validate` chains `prepare → lint → typecheck → test`:
345	
346	| Step | Tool | Why |
347	|---|---|---|
348	| `nuxi prepare` | generates `.nuxt/types/*` for auto-imports | `vue-tsc` errors on auto-imported symbols without it |
349	| `@nuxt/eslint` | lint Vue + TS + Nuxt with layer-boundary rules | replaces `eslint-config-next` |
350	| `nuxi typecheck` | `vue-tsc` strict + the three extras | `tsc --noEmit` can't read `.vue` |
351	| Vitest + `@nuxt/test-utils` | unit + component (happy-dom) | `mountSuspended` for Nuxt internals |
352	
353	Pre-push hook runs the same. CI mirrors on every PR push. Playwright (`bun run test:e2e`) is a separate, slower gate — local on demand, nightly in CI. SSR cookie assertions live in Playwright because `@nuxt/test-utils` e2e setup can't bundle under Vitest+Bun.
354	
355	## Locked decisions
356	
357	The full list lives in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md#locked-product-decisions) and [`plan.md`](./plan.md#13-locked-decisions). The ones that drove the architecture above:
358	
359	- **Multi-tenant schema, single-tenant UI** (decision #1). `organizations` table populated; no org picker in the wizard. `ownerOrgId` defaults to `"default"`.
360	- **Better Auth + Drizzle adapter** (#2). Cookie sessions; CLI device-code on the same table.
361	- **Inngest** (#3). Same SDK as the original repo; webhook on Nitro.
362	- **Supabase Storage default, R2 alternative** (#5). Pluggable via env at first use.
363	- **Locale URLs always prefixed** (#8). `@nuxtjs/i18n` owns the segment.
364	- **CLI agent-agnostic with Claude-first defaults** (#10). Per-agent install paths in the manifest; `~/.claude/...` is the default profile.
365	
366	## What's intentionally NOT in this architecture
367	
368	- **No RSC, no Vue Server Components** — Nuxt's `useAsyncData` / `useFetch` covers SSR data fetching. Vue's Server Components are not mature enough to replicate the RSC model meaningfully.
369	- **No server actions** — every Next.js `'use server'` action became a `server/api/internal/...` endpoint called over the wire.
370	- **No `revalidateTag`** — Nuxt's data layer keys per-`useFetch` call, not by tags. Reindex job sends an `extension/published` event; consuming pages refetch on next visit.
371	- **No barrel files** (`index.ts` re-exports) except `shared/db/schema/index.ts` (Drizzle needs the namespace).
372	- **No DB mocking in unit tests** — pure logic lives in `shared/` and is tested directly; DB-touching code is covered by Playwright. Mocked-DB tests are a known failure mode (mock/prod drift).
373	
```

> AGENT

Pushed. Two new commits on PR #36:

- **`7071447` docs(architecture)** — refreshed directory layout (added new pages, the ExtensionListing/PanoramaSidebarSection components, the usePanoramaState composable, the legacy-categories middleware) and added a new "Category URL structure" subsection that documents the top-level routes, the redirect map, the URL ↔ enum divergence (`/commands` ↔ `slash`), and the sidebar's mode-aware bottom swap.

- **`4c7f140` test(routing)** — 12 new tests:
  - **Middleware (9 cases):** each legacy URL canonicalizes correctly; filters (`sort`, `scope`, `layer`, `primary`, `status`) survive the rewrite; unknown categories and category-less `/extensions` URLs are left alone.
  - **Sidebar (3 new cases under `Browse MCP block`):** absent on non-MCP routes; on `/mcp` renders with `By function` as `aria-current`, `By system` as a NuxtLink to `/mcp/panorama`, FUNC_TAXONOMY below; on `/mcp/panorama` the pills swap and FUNC_TAXONOMY is replaced by the panorama section.

**One implementation note worth flagging in the commit body:** `mountSuspended` runs the component inside an isolated suspense context, so `router.replace()` in the test scope doesn't propagate to the mounted component's `useRoute()`. The fix is to pass `{ route: "/en/mcp" }` in the mount options — that's the supported way to control the route at mount time. I called this out in the commit message so the next person to write a routed-component test doesn't get stuck the same way.

Total now on PR #36: **256/256 tests passing** (12 more than before).
